title: Analytics Lead (Data & Analytics)
description:
**The Role** 




  





 This role is focused on enabling better decision\-making across the organization through high\-quality analysis and the thoughtful application of AI and advanced analytics. You will work closely with Product and Engineering to improve how we understand platform usage, performance, and outcomes, and to shape product direction through data.
 



 This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will define how analytics operates identify high\-impact opportunities and deliver meaningful analysisyourself. You will also play a key role in identifying and applying AI capabilities, particularly where they can unlock new product value or significantly improve internal decision\-making.
 



 Given the natureof data products, experience working with financialor market data is highly advantageous.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Establish the Analytics Function
 


* Define a vision, scope,and operating model for internalanalytics in collaboration with the VP Data and Analytics.
* Identify high\-impact opportunities wherebetter data and analysis can materially improvebusiness and product outcomes.
* Establish best practicesfor analysis, experimentation, metric definition, and insight communication.
* Build trust in analytics through rigor, clarity,and transparency. Product \& Engineering Partnership
* Partner closely with Product Managersand Engineering Leads to supportroadmap decisions with data.
* Support the definition and refinement of product metrics,KPIs, and successcriteria.
* Translate ambiguous productand system questionsinto structured analytical approaches.
* Support experimentation and hypothesis\-driven product development. Data Exploration \& Analysis
* Work across multiple systemsand data sources(including SaaS platforms, APIs, and operational databases) to discover and extract relevant data.
* Write queries and scripts to retrieve, combine,and prepare data for analysis.



  




* Build robust, analysis\-ready datasets across structured and semi\-structured data.
* Identify gaps in instrumentation, tracking, and data availability, and work with engineering to address them.



 AI \& Advanced AnalyticsApplication
 


* Identify opportunities to apply AI and machine learningtechniques to improveproduct functionality, internal workflows, and decision\-making.
* Prototype and evaluate AI\-drivensolutions (e.g. LLM\-powered analysis, classification, summarisation, anomaly detection).
* Work with Engineering to integrate AI capabilities into products or internal tools where appropriate.
* Stay current with emergingAI capabilities and assess theirpractical application withincompany Data and Analytics domain.
* Balance experimentation with pragmatism, focusing on real business impactover technical novelty. Insight Generation \& Decision Support
* Conduct exploratory and deep\-dive analysisto uncover trends,risks, and opportunities.
* Apply appropriate statistical methods to ensurerobust and reliableconclusions.
* Translate analysis into clear,actionable recommendations for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Develop dashboards or lightweight reporting where appropriate, with a focuson meaningful and decision\-relevant metrics.



 Grow \&Scale the Capability
 


* Expand analytics supportbeyond Product \& Engineering over time.
* Coach and mentor team members,helping to raise the overallanalytical capability of the organisation.
* Define future hiring needs and contribute to building a scalable analyticsand AI function.



 Essential Criteria
 


* Significant experience in productanalytics, decision science,or data sciencewithin a SaaS or technology environment.
* Proven experience partnering closely with Productand Engineering teams.
* Strong SQL skillsand experience workingwith large\-scale datasets.
* Experience writing scripts(e.g. Python, Spark or similar)to retrieve, combine,and analyse data.
* Strong statistical reasoning and ability to apply appropriate analytical methods.
* Experience applying AI/ML techniques to real\-world businessor product problems(e.g. predictive modelling, NLP, or LLM\-based applications).
* Familiarity with modernAI tooling and frameworks (e.g.Python ML stack,LLM APIs, or similar).
* Ability to rapidly prototype and evaluate AI\-driven approaches, and communicate their value and limitations to stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured, data\-driven analysis.
* Excellent communication skills,with a focus on influencing decisions and drivingaction.
* Comfortable operating independently and setting directionin an emerging or evolvingfunction.



 Desirable Criteria
 


* Experience in financial services, particularly workingwith trading, securities, market, or regulatory data.
* Experience establishing or scaling an internal analytics or decision sciencefunction.
* Familiarity with modernanalytics tooling (e.g. dbt, BI tools, experimentation platforms).



  




* Experience defining event tracking or instrumentation standards.
* Exposure to data governance and metric definition frameworks.



 What We Offer
 


* The opportunity to build and shape the internal analytics capability from the groundup.
* The potential to influence cross\-functional decisions throughinsight.
* Close collaboration with senior stakeholders across the organisation.
* A rapidly growingplatform with significant analytical depth and opportunity.

title: Senior Engineer - Data Analytics
description:
TJX Companies
   

  

 At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off\-price retailer.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Senior Engineer – Data Analytics**
**What You’ll Discover**
* Inclusive culture and career growth opportunities
* A truly Global IT Organization that collaborates across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia, click here to learn more
* Challenging, collaborative, and team\-based environment


**Our Organization**
 The Global Stores and Supply Chain Solution Delivery organization is responsible for delivering technology solutions to drive growth, enable efficiency, and improve customer experience at the front\-line in our stores and managing various supply chain related solutions within TJX IT.
   

  

 We are expanding our organizational footprint, and need your help to accomplish our vision! You will have a real opportunity to be a part of driving over $50B in annual revenue and make our stores a destination that our customers love.
   

  

 The Data \& Analytics function thrives on strong relationships with our business partners and working diligently to address their needs, which support TJX growth and operational stability. On this tightly knit and fast\-paced solution delivery team, you will be constantly challenged to stretch and think creatively.
   

  

 As we expand our capabilities, we are growing our presence in India to include a new focus on Data Analytics. Associates in India will work closely with global teams to mature and scale our services.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 We seek a motivated, talented Senior Engineer with good understanding of cloud architecture, data warehousing, data modeling concepts to help design enterprise data engineering and reporting solutions across global stores organization.
   

  

 You will be working with product teams, architecture and business partners to strategically plan and deliver the product features by connecting the technical and business worlds. You will need to break down complex problems into steps that drive product development while keeping product quality and security as the priority. You will be responsible for most design and technical decisions within assigned scope.
   

  

**AI \& Innovation**
* Drive adoption of Gen AI and Agentic AI to enhance analytics, automation, and decision\-making.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Build advanced Power BI dashboards, reports, and data models tailored to business needs and implement DAX calculations and optimize queries for performance.
* Create and maintain data models ensuring accuracy and scalability and connect Power BI to multiple data sources (SQL Server, Azure, APIs).
* Build JAVA/.NET/Python based UI Screens for report facilitating the reports.
* Monitor and improve report performance using best practices for data modeling and query optimization.
* Implement Row\-Level Security (RLS) and manage user access and ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
* Work closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs, translate the requirements into technical specifications and deliverables.
* Guide junior engineers and provide best practice recommendations.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to BI development standards.
* Manage Power BI Service environments, including workspaces and gateways and Support CI/CD pipelines for BI solutions.
* Stay updated on Power BI / Sigma features, data visualization trends, and Azure BI ecosystem.
* Develop solid understanding of the end\-to\-end business application processes.
* Recommend enhancements to improve reporting efficiency and user experience.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent Engineering skillset / training / work experience in relevant technical domain
* 5\+ years of strong experience in BI/reporting development, with at least 2–3 years focused on Power BI / Sigma.
* Should have good experience in UI screens development to facilitate the reports.
* Hands\-on experience in leading and delivering medium to large scale projects end to end whilst maintaining good understanding of coding standards, Performance tuning and database concepts.
* Demonstrated leadership in the fields of Reporting from data warehousing, database and data lake.
* Strong communication and influence skills. solid team player with mentorship skills.
* Ability to understand the work environment and competing priorities in conjunction with developing/meeting project goals.
* Shows a positive, open\-minded, and can\-do attitude.
* Strong automation and engineering mindset.
* Experience working in an Agile (Scrum/Kanban/SAFe) environment.


**Experience In The Following Technologies**
* Strong experience with Power BI or other enterprise BI platforms (Like : Cognos \& Sigma) for developing scalable, high\-impact dashboards, reports, and semantic data models tailored to retail operations.
* Strong proficiency in DAX and Power Query (M language) for complex business logic, data transformations, and performance optimization in large\-scale reporting environments.
* Expertise in dimensional data modelling, including star and snowflake schemas, to support consistent and reusable analytics.
* Hands\-on experience integrating Power BI or similar BI tools with Snowflake and Azure Data Factory (ADF) for building robust, automated data pipelines and analytics workflows.
* Proficient in SQL and PL/SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis across cloud (Azure, Snowflake) or on\-premises data environments.
* Experience with Python for automation, data wrangling, and enhancing BI workflows with advanced analytics or ML model outputs.
* Should have good experience in UI screens development to facilitate the reports Using JAVA/ .Net / Python.
* Working knowledge of GitHub or similar version control systems for collaborative development, code reviews, and CI/CD integration.
* Proficient in Shell Scripting for automating data workflows and managing system tasks, especially in Linux/RHEL environments.
* Familiarity with scheduling tools such as Control\-M, Autosys, or Azure Scheduler for orchestrating complex BI and data engineering jobs across distributed systems.


**Nice To Have**
* Programing languages like Spark, Python, PySpark.
* Experience with tools such as JIRA, Service NOW.
* Knowledge of IT Security \& Compliance
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices for BI solution deployment
* Familiarity with advanced analytics and machine learning integration within BI platforms


 In addition to our open door policy and supportive work environment, we also strive to provide a competitive salary and benefits package. TJX considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity and expression, marital or military status, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. TJX also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state and local law.

**Location:**

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
**Company Description**
 Founded in 2006, eHealth Technologies provides medical record retrieval, organization, and image\-enabled health information solutions. Its services help healthcare organizations obtain and organize clinical information needed to support timely patient care.
   

  

**Career Description**
 We are seeking a self\-driven Senior Data Analyst with 7\-10 years of experience to deliver accurate reporting, scalable data solutions, and actionable insights for operational and leadership decision\-making. The role requires deep expertise in SQL Server, Power BI, Salesforce data, ETL, Azure, database optimization, analytical queries, and job automation.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with exceptional attention to detail, clear communication, and ownership. This individual thrives in a fast\-paced environment, proactively seeks clarity when requirements are ambiguous, and consistently delivers trusted data products with minimal supervision.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Develop and maintain executive, operational, and ad hoc reporting using Power BI and SQL Server.
* Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable business insights.
* Translate business questions into clear metrics, KPIs, data models, and analytical solutions.
* Write and optimize complex T\-SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and data transformations.
* Analyze execution plans and improve indexing, query performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Design, build, schedule, monitor, and support ETL pipelines, scripts, and automated data\-processing jobs in Azure.
* Create data\-validation, reconciliation, exception\-reporting, and quality\-control processes.
* Extract, integrate, and analyze Salesforce data for enterprise reporting and decision support.
* Partner with leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders to clarify requirements and present findings clearly.
* Proactively communicate progress, assumptions, risks, blockers, dependencies, and data limitations.
* Own reporting accuracy, completeness, consistency, documentation, and timely delivery.
* Use approved AI\-assisted development tools to improve productivity while validating all generated output.
* Provide production support for data pipelines and reporting solutions as business needs require.
* Perform other related duties as assigned. Responsibilities may change based on business needs.


**Information Privacy And Security**
* Follow all eHealth Technologies information privacy and security policies, procedures, and standards.
* Access, use, and disclose only the minimum necessary covered information required for assigned responsibilities or otherwise permitted by law.
* Safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of covered information at all times.


**Knowledge And Skill Requirements**
**Preferred Field of Study:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering, MIS, Information Technology, or a related field from an accredited institution; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.


**Years Of Experience**
* 7\-10 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, data engineering, or a related discipline.


**Required Technical Skills**
* Expert\-level SQL Server and T\-SQL skills, including complex analytical queries, stored procedures, indexing, execution\-plan analysis, and performance optimization.
* Advanced Power BI experience, including data modeling, DAX, dashboard development, refresh strategies, and performance tuning.
* Strong experience with Salesforce reporting, data extraction, integration, and analysis.
* Hands\-on experience designing and supporting ETL pipelines, scheduled jobs, and data automation.
* Experience with Azure\-based data services and cloud\-hosted reporting or analytical solutions.
* Demonstrated experience producing accurate insights and executive\-level reporting for leadership decisions.


**Preferred Technical Skills**
* Python or C\# for data processing, automation, scripting, or ETL development.
* Experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or comparable tools.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, source control, CI/CD, data governance, and reporting quality controls.
* Experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, SaaS, or another regulated environment.


**Core Competencies**
* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills across technical, business, and leadership audiences.
* Proactively seeks clarification, validates assumptions, and resolves ambiguity before delivery.
* Self\-driven, accountable, organized, and able to manage competing priorities with minimal supervision.
* Able to thrive in a fast\-paced environment while balancing speed, quality, and reliability.
* Strong business acumen, stakeholder focus, collaboration, and continuous\-learning mindset.


**Key Relationships**
* Directly supervised by the Director of Engineering.
* Interacts regularly with eHealth Technologies leadership, technology, operations, product, business teams, customers, and vendors as required.

 As an Engineering Analyst on the YouTube Trust and Safety team, you will be directly responsible for ensuring that we effectively identify and remove disruptive content and users as quickly as possible, in an environment where hundreds of hours of new content is uploaded every minute, globally. You will be passionate about technologies and have experience with analyzing large scale data and scaled systems of review. You will thrive in a fast, dynamic, demanding environment where no two days are ever the same. You will be a key contributor to the strategy for reducing network badness on YouTube. You will be an independent, critical thinker with sound metrics judgment who has a passion for coaching others, solving technological tests and setting scalable standards. You will balance the short\-term requirements we face while demonstrating the ability to see the big picture and make quantitatively based long\-term recommendations accordingly. You may require on\-call work at weekends on a rotational basis. You will also be exposed to graphic, controversial, and sometimes offensive video content during team escalations in line with YouTube’s Community Guidelines.At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview**
 The Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting Bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. The team develops the Bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program and identifies and addresses vulnerabilities, Develops, deploys and manages a risk\-based controls portfolio, Manages and operates global security operations center that monitor, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents.
   

  

 GIS Identity \& Access management (IAM) Access Control Team goal is to ensure that the control processes and effectiveness are within the identified risk tolerance. Manage the performance and effectiveness of the working control through the establishment of metrics with thresholds. Validate the reasonability of Laws, Rules and Regulations mapping alignment to the controls, as aligned by the GIS Policy team.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Data Engineering Services team is seeking a hands\-on IAM Data Scientist to deliver advanced analytics, AI/ML solutions, and data engineering capabilities that strengthen Identity and Access Management controls, governance, and risk reduction across the enterprise.
   

  

 This role will require to transform complex access, entitlement, identity lifecycle, privileged access, and control data into actionable insights. The candidate will design and develop scalable data pipelines, predictive and detective analytics, AI/ML models, dashboards, and self\-service reporting capabilities that help identify control gaps, access anomalies, toxic combinations, certification inefficiencies, and emerging IAM risks. The role requires strong technical depth in analytics, model development, model governance, AI risk management, and responsible AI practices, with the ability to convert data science outcomes into measurable control improvements and executive\-ready risk narratives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead advanced analytics and data science initiatives across IAM controls, access governance, entitlement management, privileged access, joiner\-mover\-leaver processes, access certifications, and policy adherence.
* Analyze large, complex, and disparate identity, access, entitlement, control, application, and audit datasets to identify trends, anomalies, control gaps, risk concentrations, and opportunities for automation.
* Design, build, validate, and tune AI/ML models for IAM use cases such as access anomaly detection, entitlement mining, role mining, toxic access identification, certification prioritization, privileged access monitoring, and control effectiveness measurement.
* Develop scalable data pipelines, feature engineering processes, reusable datasets, and analytics frameworks using Python, R, SQL, Splunk, Neo4j, and enterprise\-approved data platforms.
* Design and maintain executive\-ready dashboards, scorecards, and self\-service reporting solutions that convert IAM control data into actionable insights for process owners, risk partners, and senior leadership.
* Embed model governance and AI risk controls into the analytics lifecycle, including documentation, model inventory, validation evidence, explainability, performance monitoring, drift detection, data lineage, reproducibility, and audit traceability.
* Assess and mitigate AI/ML risks including bias, privacy exposure, data quality limitations, explainability gaps, inappropriate automation, overfitting, and adversarial or unintended use of model outputs.

* Drive experimentation strategies and data\-driven decision making through online and offline evaluation.
* Influence product strategy through deep analysis of user behavior, product outcomes, and AI quality signals.
* Partner with Engineering, Product Management, Design, Research, and Responsible AI teams to bring innovations into production.
* Advance techniques in natural language understanding, retrieval, reasoning, and contextual intelligence to improve experience quality.
* Mentor senior scientists and help define best practices for machine learning experimentation, measurement science, and AI quality evaluation.

* Represent Microsoft through publications, patents, technical reviews, and industry engagement.

* Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 6\+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research).
+ OR Master's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 4\+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research).
+ OR Doctorate in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 3\+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research).
+ OR equivalent experience.

* Deep expertise in:Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Retrieval (IR), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG, Conversational AI, Knowledge Representation, Machine Learning for Language and Productivity Applications, Strong background in experimentation, Causal inference, statistical analysis, and measurement science.

* Experience working with cloud\-scale AI services and distributed systems.

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 9\+ years of experience in Data Science, Applied Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines. Proven track record of driving significant product impact through large\-scale AI and machine learning systems.
* Experience developing evaluation systems for generative AI and agent\-assisted user experiences.

* 15\+ years of overall experience with strong hands\-on expertise in data engineering testing, ETL validation, QA automation, or data warehouse environments.

**Required Experience**

* Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and modern cloud\-based data engineering practices.
* Proficiency in SQL, Python, and basic Unix/shell scripting to develop automation scripts and support testing, validation, automation, and troubleshooting.
* Experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools to help create, refine, and optimize automation scripts and testing accelerators while applying sound engineering judgment, validation, and governance.
* Experience with Agile delivery tools such as Jira or Rally, with a solid understanding of software development lifecycle practices.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, defect diagnosis, test evidence review, and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Ability to manage priorities independently, communicate clearly, and deliver high\-quality work within tight timelines.

**Skills And Attributes**

 Following up with others to ensure that agreements and commitments have been fulfilled

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. **What You Will Do**

* You'll support operational excellence by maintaining reporting templates, assisting with onboarding activities, coordinating routine handoffs with stakeholders, resolving routine data\-related queries, identifying recurring issues, and contributing recommendations that support process improvements and enhanced reporting efficiency.
* You'll collaborate effectively with team members and stakeholders, share knowledge and best practices, complete training and workflow requirements, manage multiple priorities, and maintain high standards of accuracy, professionalism, and continuous learning.

* Allowances \& Support: Transportation/transport allowance and shift allowance.

title: Revenue Operations Analyst
description:
**About StarRez**
 StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off\-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400\+ clients across 25\+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user\-friendly, all\-in\-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.
   

  

 About the Role:
   

  

 We are looking for a detail\-oriented and analytical
 **Revenue Operations Analyst** 
 to join our growing Revenue Operations team in Hyderabad, India.
   

  

 This role will be a key member of the team responsible for the operational work that keeps our go\-to\-market organization running effectively. The Revenue Operations Analyst will focus primarily on data management, process execution, system testing, reporting, commissions support, and maintaining the accuracy and reliability of our revenue operations processes.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys working with data and systems, investigating problems, and improving how work gets done. You will work closely with the Director of Revenue Operations and other members of the RevOps team while partnering with our Salesforce administrators and other teams when needed.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has 2–3\+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a similar role and is comfortable independently owning recurring operational processes from start to finish.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 CRM \& Data Operations
   

  

* Maintain accurate and reliable data within Salesforce through bulk uploads, updates, corrections, and data cleanup.
* Perform recurring audits to identify missing, inaccurate, duplicate, or inconsistent CRM data.
* Execute account, contact, opportunity, territory, and ownership updates.
* Use tools such as Clay and other enrichment platforms to enrich and maintain account and contact data.
* Investigate data discrepancies and determine the appropriate corrective action.
* Support data cleanup, migration, and enrichment projects.
* Maintain account hierarchies and other key CRM data structures.
* Help ensure adherence to established CRM data standards and processes.


 Salesforce \& GTM Systems Testing
   

  

* Test new Salesforce workflows, automations, fields, validation rules, and other changes developed by our Salesforce administration team.
* Execute user acceptance testing (UAT) and regression testing before system changes are released.
* Develop and maintain repeatable test cases and testing checklists.
* Document defects, unexpected behavior, and testing results.
* Validate that data is flowing correctly between Salesforce and connected GTM systems.
* Investigate and document system or integration issues before escalating them to the appropriate technical owner.
* Perform post\-release validation to confirm changes are functioning as expected.


 Revenue Operations Processes
   

  

* Own and execute recurring Revenue Operations processes accurately and on schedule.
* Support commission processing, including preparing commission statements, validating inputs, and reconciling commission data.
* Process CRM data corrections, account and opportunity changes, ownership updates, and other operational requests.
* Support territory and account assignment updates.
* Perform pipeline hygiene checks and identify opportunities requiring correction or review.
* Support lead and account routing quality assurance.
* Assist with month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end Revenue Operations processes.
* Maintain operational checklists and controls to ensure critical processes are completed consistently.


 Reporting \& Analytics
   

  

* Build and maintain recurring Salesforce reports and dashboards.
* Prepare recurring reports, data exports, and operational analyses.
* Validate report accuracy and investigate discrepancies between data sources.
* Support pipeline, bookings, conversion, productivity, and other revenue\-related reporting.
* Perform ad hoc analysis and data requests as needed.
* Identify opportunities to automate or streamline recurring reporting processes.


 Process Improvement \& Documentation
   

  

* Identify repetitive or manual operational processes that can be standardized, simplified, or automated.
* Create and maintain SOPs, process documentation, testing procedures, and operational checklists.
* Maintain documentation of key CRM fields, definitions, and business rules.
* Help establish repeatable quality\-control processes across Revenue Operations.
* Proactively identify data issues, process gaps, and operational risks and recommend improvements.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 2–3\+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, or a related role.
* Hands\-on experience working with Salesforce in a Sales or Revenue Operations environment.
* Experience performing Salesforce data imports, exports, bulk updates, and data cleanup.
* Strong Excel and/or Google Sheets skills and comfort working with large datasets.
* Experience creating and maintaining Salesforce reports and dashboards.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to investigate discrepancies and troubleshoot operational issues.
* Ability to independently manage recurring processes and meet deadlines.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple operational requests and projects.
* Ability to document processes clearly and consistently.
* Comfortable collaborating with colleagues across different teams and time zones.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience with Clay or other data enrichment platforms.
* Experience supporting sales commissions or incentive compensation processes.
* Experience performing UAT or regression testing for Salesforce or other GTM systems.
* Familiarity with sales engagement, forecasting, conversation intelligence, marketing automation, or other GTM platforms.
* Experience with data visualization or BI tools.
* Familiarity with SQL or other data querying tools.
* Experience working in a SaaS or B2B technology company.


 What Success Looks Like:
   

  

 Within your first several months, you will become a dependable owner of key Revenue Operations processes and develop a strong understanding of our Salesforce data, GTM systems, and operating processes.
   

  

 Success in this role means that recurring operational work is completed accurately and on time, CRM data remains reliable, system changes are thoroughly tested, issues are identified before they impact the business, and Revenue Operations processes become increasingly documented, repeatable, and scalable.
   

  

 As you grow in the role, you will take ownership of additional processes and help identify opportunities to make our Revenue Operations function more efficient and automated.
   

  

 StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Lead Business Analyst - Project Financial Management

Partnering with PFM leadership, Project Managers, Finance, Procurement, and delivery teams, this role delivers insights and analytics that improve financial visibility, data quality, forecast accuracy, and business decision\-making.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial Analysis \& Reporting**
* Develop and maintain financial reports, dashboards, scorecards, and analytical summaries for project and portfolio stakeholders.

* Ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across financial, project management, and reporting platforms.
* Perform variance, trend, forecast accuracy, spend management, and portfolio health analyses.
* Support monthly close activities and translate complex financial data into clear insights and recommendations.


**Governance, Controls \& Compliance**
* Support Project Financial Management governance processes, standards, controls, and compliance requirements across assigned portfolio areas.
* Assist with project audits, financial reviews, capitalization activities, accrual processes, and issue resolution.
* Maintain governance documentation, supporting records, and reporting artifacts.
* Identify financial and operational risks and escalate concerns or corrective actions as appropriate.


**Data Quality \& Operational Excellence**
* Identify, investigate, and resolve data quality issues within financial and operational workflows.
* Partner with Finance, Procurement, and Project Managers to resolve discrepancies and improve spend data accuracy across systems and reports.
* Support initiatives that improve reporting accuracy, operational efficiency, governance compliance, and data integrity.
* Assist in establishing controls and validation processes that improve reporting consistency.


**AI, Analytics \& Automation**
* Use Generative AI, analytics, and automation tools to improve reporting, analysis, forecasting, and documentation.
* Identify and support automation and AI\-enabled solutions that reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency.
* Develop and enhance dashboards, data visualizations, and reporting tools using Power BI and other analytics platforms.
* Evaluate emerging AI, analytics, and automation capabilities and recommend practical business applications.


**Process Documentation \& Continuous Improvement**
* Develop and maintain process documentation, job aids, standard operating procedures, and governance materials.
* Support knowledge management and maintain team documentation repositories.
* Identify and advance improvements to financial processes, reporting methods, business workflows, and user experience.
* Drive continuous improvement activities that increase efficiency, transparency, and consistency across financial operations.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Collaborate with Project Managers, Finance, Procurement, Product Leaders, and business stakeholders.
* Communicate financial information and analytical insights clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Support governance reviews, portfolio discussions, and financial planning activities.
* Build cross\-functional relationships to align on financial objectives, reporting requirements, and portfolio priorities.
* Manage competing priorities independently while delivering high\-quality, timely work.


**Qualifications**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Information Systems, Economics, Business Analytics, or a related field.
* 4–6 years of experience in Project Financial Management, Financial Analysis, PMO Operations, FP\&A, Technology Financial Management, Business Analysis, or related disciplines.
* Experience supporting medium\- to large\-scale technology, digital transformation, or business initiatives in cross\-functional, matrixed environments.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and deliver quality work in a fast\-paced environment.


**Financial \& Business Skills**
* Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, accruals, capitalization, variance analysis, financial reporting, and close activities.
* Knowledge of project lifecycle financial management, portfolio governance, IT investment categories, and capital versus operating expenditures.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify trends, investigate issues, and develop data\-driven recommendations.
* Ability to interpret complex data and communicate clear, actionable insights to stakeholders.
* High attention to detail with a strong commitment to data accuracy and quality.


**Technical Expertise**
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Power Query, lookups, data modeling, and analytical functions.
* Strong PowerPoint, presentation, and business communication skills.
* Experience with Power BI, data visualization, large datasets, and enterprise reporting solutions.

description:

description:

 :

 We're looking for a Deputy Manager – Marketing to own and scale Performance Marketing and Demand Generation at WhiteCoats. * Own performance marketing end\-to\-end across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and other paid channels \- planning, execution, optimization, and reporting — to consistently hit target CPL and CAC.

* Track, analyze, and present key metrics \- CPL, CAC, MQLs, SQLs, funnel conversion rates, ROI — translating data into clear recommendations for leadership.
* Run structured A/B tests across ad creatives, landing pages, and messaging to continuously lift conversion rates and lower acquisition costs.
* Collaborate with Content and Design teams to develop high\-converting creatives, landing pages, case studies, and campaign assets.
* Monitor the performance marketing and MarTech landscape, including platform updates, industry best practices, and competitor activity.
* AI\-Led Utilization: Champion the adoption of AI\-powered marketing and automation tools to improve campaign efficiency, speed up experimentation, and sharpen targeting and personalization.
* Stay ahead of AI marketing tactics and workflows and bring emerging AI tools and best practices into the team’s day\-to\-day playbook.



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  




* MBA in Marketing from a recognized institute (Preferable).



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* 7\+ years of hands\-on experience in performance marketing and/or demand generation.
* Proven track record of independently managing paid media budgets across Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and with demonstrable impact on CPL/CAC and pipeline growth.
* Strong command of the demand\-generation funnel — lead scoring, nurture workflows, MQL/SQL definitions, and sales\-marketing alignment.
* Hands\-on experience with marketing automation and CRM platforms (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, WebEngage, or similar).
* A data\-first mindset — comfortable working in GA4, Excel/Google Sheets, and dashboarding tools, and able to turn numbers into decisions.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work cross\-functionally across Sales, Product, and Leadership.

 We are seeking an experienced SAP IBP Solution Architect to lead the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of end\-to\-end Integrated Business Planning solutions. Operating at the intersection of supply chain strategy and technology, you will translate complex business planning requirements into scalable, best\-practice SAP IBP architectures — while guiding clients or internal stakeholders from discovery through go\-live and beyond.

**Solution Design \& Architecture**
* Own the end\-to\-end architecture of SAP IBP implementations across one or more planning domains.
* Define data models, integration patterns, and system landscape for IBP deployments within an SAP S/4HANA or hybrid ecosystem.
* Translate business requirements into functional and technical solution blueprints, including fit\-gap analysis and design decisions.
* Establish best\-practice configuration standards and ensure alignment with SAP's quarterly release roadmap.


**Delivery \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Lead or support full project lifecycle activities: workshops, blueprint, build, testing, hypercare, and handover.
* Engage C\-suite and VP\-level supply chain stakeholders; present architectures, trade\-offs, and recommendations with clarity.

title: Senior Manager, Analytics Products and Technology - Obesity
description:
Senior Manager, Analytics Products \& Technology
   

  

**Obesity Intelligence \& Analytics \| Amgen India**
**Reports to:** 
 Director, Technology, Operations \& Data Enablement
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 This is an India\-based global role supporting Amgen's global obesity business. The Senior Manager, Analytics Products \& Technology will own the development and evolution of business\-facing products that enable leaders to move from insight to action with clarity and speed.
   

  

 It is a product leadership role at its core \- requiring strong judgment, technical fluency, and a deep understanding of how leaders make decisions. The focus is on creating products that simplify complexity, accelerate decisions, and meaningfully improve how the organization operates.
   

  

 This leader's mandate is to build products that serve as critical enablers of how the business plans, prioritizes, and executes. This leader will shape their direction, ensure they evolve with the needs of the organization, and drive adoption in a way that makes them indispensable to everyday work.
   

  

 The role also plays a key part in advancing AI\-enabled capabilities and intelligent automation across the organization. As new opportunities emerge, this leader will help bring them to life in a way that is practical, scalable, and grounded in real business impact \- ensuring that innovation translates into meaningful change, not experimentation for its own sake.
   

  

 Success is measured by products that become part of how the business runs—trusted, widely adopted, and consistently making work faster, simpler, and more effective.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Product Strategy, Roadmap \& Technology Prioritization
* Own the product roadmap for Gateway, SKU Solver, and related decision\-support capabilities, ensuring each product solves a real business problem and earns a place in everyday work.
* Shape user journeys, requirements, backlogs, release plans, value measures, and success criteria that connect product work to business decisions.
* Prioritize with discipline, balancing user value, technical feasibility, adoption potential, speed, risk, and long\-term maintainability.
* Bring structure to ambiguity so teams understand what is being built, why it matters, and how it will change the way the organization plans, prioritizes, or executes.
* Product Discovery, Design \& User Experience
* Work closely with leaders, analytics teams, and end users to understand how decisions are made today and where products can remove friction.
* Turn complex workflows into simple product concepts, intuitive experiences, and practical solution designs that help users move from insight to action.
* Challenge requests that add complexity without value, and redirect teams toward solutions that are useful, scalable, and easy to adopt.
* Partner with design, engineering, data, analytics, and business teams to test assumptions early and refine solutions before significant build effort is committed.
* Keep the user experience central. The best product is not the one with the most features; it is the one people trust and use.
* Tool Delivery, Build Execution \& Release Management
* Lead delivery of business\-facing tools, product enhancements, dashboards, workflow applications, and reusable capabilities from concept through release.
* Ensure solutions are secure, reliable, supportable, documented, and aligned with enterprise technology standards before they scale.
* Manage delivery trade\-offs clearly, keeping momentum without sacrificing quality, usability, maintainability, or stakeholder trust.
* Build the muscle for repeatable delivery so new products and enhancements move faster over time without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* AI\-Enabled Solutions \& Intelligent Automation
* Serve as the first\-line product lead for practical AI\-enabled tools and intelligent automation opportunities until a dedicated AI capability is established.
* Help teams frame the business problem, define the desired outcome, identify required inputs, and determine whether AI or automation is the right solution.
* Coordinate with data science, technology, privacy, security, legal, compliance, and business partners to prototype and deploy custom solutions responsibly.
* Apply appropriate guardrails for documentation, validation, human oversight, user training, responsible use, and ongoing support.
* Focus on useful AI. The goal is not experimentation for its own sake; it is work that becomes faster, simpler, higher quality, or more scalable.
* Adoption, Value Realization \& Product Operations
* Own product adoption plans, usage metrics, feedback loops, training support, release communications, and value realization tracking.
* Listen to users after launch. Understand where tools create leverage, where they create friction, and where process or behavior change is needed.
* Use evidence to sharpen priorities, retire low\-value features, improve existing capabilities, and scale what proves useful.
* Measure success by adoption, trust, and decision impact, not by the number of features shipped.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership, Vendor Management \& Capability Building
* Lead an India\-based product and technology pod that can manage tools from idea through build, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Work across analytics, data enablement, commercial, medical, operations, technology, and external partners to keep product delivery connected to real business needs.
* Manage vendor and partner work with clear expectations for scope, quality, timelines, documentation, knowledge transfer, supportability, and ownership.
* Coach team members to combine product judgment, technical curiosity, business context, disciplined execution, and accountability for outcomes.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Doctorate degree and 4\+ years of relevant experience; OR
* Master's degree and 8\+ years of relevant experience; OR
* Bachelor's degree and 10\+ years of relevant experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Analytics, Data Science, Business, Life Sciences, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience owning and evolving business\-facing products, analytics platforms, workflow applications, or decision\-support capabilities from strategy through adoption and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated success building and scaling products that materially improved business decision\-making, operational efficiency, user adoption, or organizational effectiveness.
* Experience evaluating, prototyping, or deploying AI\-enabled capabilities, intelligent automation, or decision\-support solutions in an enterprise environment.
* Experience influencing cross\-functional stakeholders, engineering teams, vendors, and business leaders to deliver complex products in a global environment.
* Demonstrated ability to bring structure to ambiguous business problems, make sound product trade\-offs, and align diverse stakeholders around clear product decisions.
* Experience driving product adoption, change management, and value realization through user engagement, measurement, and continuous improvement.
* Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear product strategies, priorities, and business recommendations for senior leaders.

title: Senior Business Analyst IAM
description:
Please find the preferred qualifications for the BA role.
 



  





 The ideal candidate has prior experience with more than one of the IAM tools and process listed, such as
 **IGA, SailPoint, UER. RBAC, AuthN/Z, OKTA, RSA, AWS and Azure as well as vaulting tools CA and Hashi.** 
 They will have experience in processes (Design, Deployment, Adoption, Provisioning and Deprovisioning and Protocols and Standards) and possesses the skill to effectively communicate and liaise with both business and technical stakeholders to integrate IAM tools into the enterprise, making certain proper access governance is achieved. The Business Analyst is also responsible for maintaining the integrity of the requirements throughout the integration life cycle.
 



  





 Primary responsibilities include:
 



  





 Collaborating with key stakeholders and other available resources, facilitating discussions, analyzing and evaluating options and providing recommended course of action to remain compliant, meeting both policy and integration requirements
 



 Conducting business needs and functional/non\-functional requirements elicitation and completing functional requirements documentation through the full sign\-off process for IAM tool integration and maintenance requirements
 



 Managing all tasks assigned within scope, quality and timeframe allocated and be accountable for those tasks
 



 Proactively identifying and recording risks, issues, dependencies and assumptions in accordance with policy and process standards. Agreeing on escalation level with Management, then managing those risks through to resolution, including the required evidence
 



 Assist in the development and maintenance of IAM policies, standards, procedures, and control documentation
 



 Perform data analysis to identify access anomalies, orphan accounts, uncorrelated accounts, stale access, and control deficiencies
 



 Required Skills/Experience:
 



  





 Minimum of 5 years previous experience as a Business Analyst (including requirements elicitation)
 



 Previous experience with Agile methodology leveraging JIRA
 



 Strong understanding of one or more of the following: Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Authentication, Authorization, and Federation concepts
 



 Hands on experience with one or more of the following: IGA SailPoint experience, Okta/Ping/MFA experience, CyberArk and Hashi experience
 



 Demonstrated experience leading application onboarding and IAM integration initiatives across complex enterprise environments, including coordination of application owners, development teams, information security, risk, compliance, and infrastructure stakeholders to ensure successful implementation of identity governance controls and access management capabilities
 



 Experience working with cloud environments such as AWS and Azure, including IAM\-related capabilities
 



 Flexibility to work on a variety of projects and initiatives
 



 Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 



 Strong analytical, organizational, time management and planning skills
 



 Adaptive to environments of change; able to reprioritize with competing priorities
 



 Sense of urgency to respond to requests with strict deadlines
 



 Thought provoking; ability to ask questions and probe to gain full understanding of requirements
 



 Familiar with Software Development Lifecycle processes
 



 Competent use of Microsoft Office applications to include Microsoft Project, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, Word
 



  





 Immediate\- serving NP preferred.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
**About Tide**
 At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
   

  

 Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
   

  

 Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
   

  

**Tide Facts**
* Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members across UK and India
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* Over 2,800 Tideans globally
* Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg


**About The Role**
 As a
 **Senior Product Analyst ( Member Acquisition Marketing )** 
 , you’ll be responsible for managing insights projects related to member growth \& acquisition.
   

  

**As a Product Analyst You’ll Be**
* Presenting insights to stakeholders \& senior management, translating analysis into the 'so what?' and identifying possible actions to take as a result
* Using your SQL/Python expertise to interrogate our data to solve key business problems
* Focusing on improving performance marketing and growth initiatives by providing full stack descriptive to prescriptive analytics via cutting edge technologies to support business objectives
* Ability to deal with ambiguity \& form ambiguous questions into defined solutions to improve the business area
* Support to build analytics roadmap for customer strategy, acquisition efficiency, customer lifetime value enhancement and budget optimization.
* Collaborate with Analytical engineering and Martech to create a holistic view of the members by ensuring seamless integration of various data sources from 3rd party platforms like Google Ads, Facebook Ads, etc.
* Advising and Support performance marketing stakeholders to provide an accurate view of the member attribution by various channels
* Measuring and report performance of all marketing campaigns, and assess ROI and other key KPIs
* Supporting Analytics leadership in prioritisation and identification of various business cases
* Refine work items with the business to the point where they can be worked upon and ensure timely and quality deliverables
* Champion powerful storytelling, prioritisation, commercial and growth mindset
* Presenting insights to stakeholders \& senior management, translating analysis into the 'so what?' and identifying possible actions to take as a result


**What Makes You a Great Fit**
* 6\+ years of experience working in the analytics team of a digital product. Experience working in fintech firms preferred ( not mandatory)
* You have experience in Performance Marketing is mandatory
* You have a sound understanding of how the different digital Marketing tools work
* You have a good understanding of digital marketing, A/B testing, Google Analytics, Appsflyer, etc.
* You have a good understanding of Multi touch attribution, Marketing Mix Modelling, Cohort Analysis, Customer Lifetime Value.
* You have excellent leadership skills \- you can drive and influence team of analysts, engineers and data scientists without any formal reporting
* You have strong skills on SQL and Visualization tools ( Looker, Tableau, Qlikview etc.)
* You have great Storytelling skills and the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to business users
* You have unblock problems for your team\- be it on querying data, understanding business logic or the best way to visually represent an information!
* You have good understanding of the business \- you quickly identify which metrics are relevant for an area and anticipate which data projects will add value
* You have ability to effectively form relationships with the business in order to help with the adoption of data driven decision making
* You have self\-starter \- you take initiative in spotting opportunities and finding ways to solve challenges with data
* You have ability to deal with ambiguity and competing objectives in a fast paced environment


**What You’ll Get In Return**
* Competitive Compensation \- competitive salary and share options
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top\-up options.
* Life \& Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* Volunteering \& Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* Learning \& Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.

 While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face\-to\-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team\-building, where we encourage regular in\-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

title: Associate Field effectiveness
description:
At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission \- to serve patients living with serious illnesses \- drives all that we do.
   

  

 Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas \- Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease \- we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Let's do this. Let's change the world. In this vital role, the Associate, Field Effectiveness will provide hands\-on analytical and operational support that helps improve the productivity and effectiveness of the sales force. The role sits at the intersection of data analytics, commercial operations, and field strategy, with a focus on accurate execution, actionable insights, and reliable field enablement.
   

  

 This position reports to a Senior Manager within Field Excellence and works closely with field leadership, analytics, reporting, incentive compensation, data\-management, and cross\-system partners.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Field Data Analysis and Insights
   

  

* Analyze data from Veeva CRM, distribution partners, claims, patient services, and other approved commercial sources.
* Assess reach, frequency, HCP engagement, call\-plan adherence, account performance, and targeting effectiveness for field sales teams.
* Prepare recurring and ad hoc analyses that translate complex datasets into clear observations and practical actions for business partners.


 Operational Execution and Field Enablement
   

  

* Support territory alignments, roster updates, targeting cycles, and call\-plan execution in accordance with agreed timelines and controls.
* Coordinate operational delivery of field tools and outputs, including Veeva CRM, Next Best Action dashboards, digital companion tools, alerts, and call\-plan refreshes.
* Respond to routine field or stakeholder questions, investigate issues, document findings, and escalate risks or dependencies promptly.


 Sales Force Size, Structure, and Deployment
   

  

* Assist with analyses of field\-force size, structure, coverage, deployment, territory design, and workload balance.
* Support evaluations of customer and account potential, targeting logic, call frequency, capacity, and affordable coverage scenarios.
* Prepare data, scenarios, and quality checks required for alignment updates driven by market dynamics and business priorities.


 Field Force Effectiveness
   

  

* Support call planning, coverage optimization, targeting, valuation, and execution audits across applicable brands and field forces.
* Conduct periodic analyses of workload balance, reach and frequency, engagement quality, and performance trends under the guidance of senior team members.
* Develop clear summaries, charts, and supporting documentation for leadership reviews and cross\-functional discussions.


 Compliance, Quality, and Process Optimization
   

  

* Execute defined quality\-control checks and ensure analytics, reports, and field outputs follow approved business rules and applicable engagement\-compliance requirements.
* Document data sources, assumptions, methodologies, process steps, and validation evidence to support audit readiness, repeatability, and knowledge transfer.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, or automate recurring work and support implementation of approved improvements.


 Project Support and Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Track deliverables, issues, dependencies, decisions, and action items using tools such as Jira and ServiceNow; maintain clear ownership and timely status updates.
* Maintain project documentation, including timelines, decision logs, issue trackers, validation files, and closure summaries.
* Collaborate effectively with Field Reporting, Incentive Compensation, iDNA/data teams, analytics, cross\-system operations, and field stakeholders to deliver agreed priorities.


**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Master's degree or Bachelor's degree and 1 \- 3 years of experience in sales analytics, sales operations, commercial analytics, and/or field effectiveness.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in the bio/pharmaceutical or healthcare industry.
* Hands\-on ability to write SQL queries and perform data analysis, data visualization, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Experience with sales\-planning or operations platforms used for targeting, alignment, roster management, and call planning.
* Familiarity with CRM systems such as Veeva and with commercial data such as sales, activity, claims, and customer/account data.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to identify data\-quality issues and explain findings clearly.
* Effective written and verbal communication, collaboration, and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.


**What You Can Expect Of Us**
 As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well\-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we'll support your journey every step of the way.
   

  

 In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity and Accommodation
   

  

 As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed, and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

title: Advisory Senior - Healthcare Consulting
description:
**Job Description**
 At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one\-of\-a\-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.
   

  

 EisnerAmper is seeking a
 **Senior Consultant** 
 for our
 **Health Care Consulting Group** 
 . In this role, you will focus on client service projects pertaining to Hospitals and Medical Centers, Physician Practices and Networks, Government Entities, and Accountable Care Organizations. In addition, you will be responsible for supporting senior staff and management to execute client engagements, as well as to manage and coordinate project objectives, inclusive of research, analytics, assessments, deliverable creation, and client management.
   

  

**What it Means to Work for EisnerAmper:**
* You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
* You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance
* You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards
+ We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create new solutions
+ We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
+ Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work


**What Work You Will be Responsible For:**
* Support and execute consulting engagements including all aspects of client work, such as Research, Data Requests \& Collection, Analysis and Financial Modeling, and participation in client follow\-ups and management. Plan and prepare deliverable reports for review and presentation to firm and client leadership
* Perform required analysis to understand current and potential opportunities in client performance based on specific key performance indicators (ex. wRVU productivity, admissions, charge, collections, denials, AR, etc.)
* Conduct benchmarking analysis using national data sets and internal proprietary data and develop and implement new procedures to improve the quality and quantity of work processed
* Assist in the development and sales process with potential clients, inclusive of introductory and formal sales process presentations
* Establish and maintain a working relationship with all current clients. Provide updates on marketplace changes in regulations in efforts to both educate clients and establish opportunities for continued client engagements
* Maintain knowledge of and comply with established policies and procedures including patients, government, insurance and third\-party payer regulations
* May be required to occasionally work extended hours, or travel to/work from different firm offices and/or client locations


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Health Administration, or related field is required
* 3 \+ years of related and progressive health care management consulting or health care financial and operations experience


**Preferred/Desired Qualifications:**
* Master’s Degree in Business, Health Administration, or related field is preferred
* Revenue Cycle Management experience is preferred


 We strongly believe in a supportive work environment where all our colleagues can succeed. EisnerAmper India is proud to be an Equal Opportunity merit\-based employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of caste \& religion, disabilities, gender, sexual orientation, age or marital status.
   

  

**About our Healthcare Sector Services Group:**
 The Health Care Consulting Group provides tailored services to a wide range of clients: hospitals and health systems, academic medical centers, physician and ancillary services practices, entrepreneurs and PE Firms, managed care entities and government agencies.
   

  

 EisnerAmper assists our health care clients in creating and maintaining a value\-based network, implementing positive operational improvements and building sustainable plans to meet strategic, financial and growth goals.
   

  

 The Health Care Consulting Group takes a hands\-on approach to optimize performance and revenue through improved operations, governance structures and planning processes while leveraging data and analytics. The team has significant experience with deal structure design, valuation, and negotiations, as well as value\-based contracting and assessing clinical programs.
   

  

**About EisnerAmper:**
 EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with nearly 5,000 employees including 450 partners across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long\-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow.
   

  

 Our clients are enterprises as diverse as sophisticated financial institutions and start\-ups, global public firms, and middle\-market companies, as well as high net worth individuals, family offices, not\-for\-profit organizations, and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries. We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers, and investors who serve these clients.
   

  

**About EisnerAmper India:**
 EisnerAmper (India) Consultants Pvt. Ltd. (“EA India”) is a subsidiary of Eisner Advisory Group LLC (“EA Group”), which practices in an alternative practice structure with EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees provide advisory services to clients of EA Group and audit services to clients of EisnerAmper LLP and comply with the professional standards applicable to each of EA India, EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees also provide operational services to EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. The policies and procedures of EA India, including obligations of confidentiality and non\-disclosure, apply to all services provided by EA India employees. All applicants are applying to positions for employment with EA India, and not EA Group or EisnerAmper LLP.
   

  

 EA India opened its first office in Mumbai in 2007\. Over the years, our India footprint has
   

  

 expanded to include offices in Bangalore, Hyderabad and Ahmedabad. We are a culturally diverse pool of over 900 professionals supporting our global clientele from a range of startups to Fortune 500 entities.
   

  

 Should you need any accommodations to complete this application please email: indiata@eisneramper.com

title: E-commerce, Marketplace Growth & Listings Manager
description:
**E\-commerce, Marketplace Growth \& Listings Manager
 
 ﻿**




 📍 Hyderabad \| Full\-time
 



  





**A Note from the Founders** 




 Most marketplace roles eventually become coordination roles.
 



 Listings get uploaded, campaigns go live, sales happen — but very few people truly think about how catalogue quality, platform visibility, and operational execution directly impact long\-term revenue growth.
 



 At SkinBae, we are building this differently.
 



 We are looking for someone who naturally thinks about:
 


* how brands scale across marketplaces
* how listings influence conversion and discoverability
* how marketplace growth and operations connect together
* how systems can be built to reduce errors and improve efficiency at scale



 This role is not just about managing listings or operations. It is about building scalable marketplace growth engines across multiple Korean beauty brands.
 



 If you enjoy ownership, growth strategy, optimization, and execution, you’ll enjoy being here.
 



  





**About SkinBae** 




 SkinBae is building a curated Korean skincare platform in India. We work closely with global Korean beauty brands and focus on education\-led storytelling, strong visual identity, and long\-term brand building across D2C, marketplaces, and offline retail.
 



 As we continue scaling across marketplaces, we are looking for people who can combine growth thinking with operational excellence and execute at a high level across multiple brands and channels.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 This role combines marketplace growth, commercial strategy, catalogue management, listing optimization, and operational execution across major marketplaces including Amazon, Nykaa, TIRA, Myntra, Flipkart, and emerging quick\-commerce channels.
 



 You will own marketplace performance, catalogue quality, visibility optimization, and launch execution across a portfolio of Korean beauty brands.
 



 You will work closely with marketplace teams, operations, marketing, design, and leadership to ensure strong revenue growth while maintaining operational accuracy and scalability.
 



  





**What You Will Own1\. Marketplace Growth \& Revenue Ownership** 



* Own GMV growth and marketplace performance across platforms
* Drive revenue growth while balancing profitability and operational efficiency
* Build marketplace\-specific growth strategies based on:
* Consumer behaviour
* Category trends
* Platform dynamics
* Brand positioning

**2\. Commercial Strategy \& Marketplace Management** 



* Lead marketplace discussions around:
* Margins and commissions
* TOTs / MDF
* Sale participation
* Visibility spends
* Assortment expansion
* Ensure marketplace investments are ROI\-driven

* Manage the complete listing lifecycle:
* Creation
* QC
* Go\-live
* Optimization
* Maintenance
* Handle:
* Bulk uploads
* Variation mapping
* Catalogue updates
* Listing maintenance
* Suppression resolution
* Ensure all listings are:
* Accurate
* SEO optimized
* Marketplace compliant
* Conversion\-ready



  





**4\. PDP Optimization \& SEO** 



* Optimize:
* Product titles
* Bullet points
* Descriptions
* A\+ content
* Backend keywords
* Brand stores
* Improve:
* Organic ranking
* Discoverability
* Click\-through rates
* Conversion rates
* Ensure PDPs align with:
* Marketplace algorithms
* SEO best practices
* Brand positioning



  





**5\. Catalogue Data \& Compliance Management** 



* Maintain Master SKU Tracker across brands and marketplaces
* Standardize:
* SKU naming
* Attributes
* Category mapping
* Barcode structures
* Ensure compliance with:
* MRP regulations
* Country of origin requirements
* Ingredient declarations
* Importer details
* Shelf\-life requirements
* Maintain:
* MSDS documents
* Certifications
* Product documentation



  





**6\. Brand Launches \& Go\-to\-Market Execution** 



* Manage launch readiness for:
* New brands
* New product launches
* Marketplace onboarding
* Ensure:
* Timely go\-live
* Content readiness
* Compliance approvals
* Inventory mapping
* Marketplace coordination
* Align launch timelines with campaigns and sale events



  





**7\. Marketplace Visibility \& Demand Generation** 



* Coordinate with marketing teams for:
* Marketplace campaigns
* Influencer initiatives
* Sale visibility
* Banner opportunities
* Search ranking improvements
* Support demand generation activities across marketplaces



  





**8\. Listing Health \& Operational Excellence** 



* Monitor and resolve:
* Listing suppressions
* Catalogue mismatches
* Mapping issues
* Content rejections
* Account health concerns
* Coordinate with marketplace teams for faster issue resolution
* Ensure minimal listing downtime and operational disruption



  





**9\. SOP Building \& Cross\-Functional Coordination** 



* Build and improve SOPs for:
* Catalogue workflows
* Listing management
* QC processes
* Marketplace execution
* Introduce systems and process improvements to reduce errors
* Coordinate closely with:
* Operations team
* Marketing team
* Design team
