title: Senior Workday Integration Analyst
description:
**LiveRamp is the data collaboration platform of choice for the world’s most innovative companies. A groundbreaking leader in consumer privacy, data ethics, and foundational identity, LiveRamp is setting the new standard for building a connected customer view with unmatched clarity and context while protecting precious brand and consumer trust. LiveRamp offers complete flexibility to collaborate wherever data lives to support the widest range of data collaboration use cases—within organizations, between brands, and across its premier global network of top\-quality partners.**

******You Will:******

* Track and evaluate new Workday integration features and product roadmap changes, assess potential impact to LiveRamp’s ecosystem, and lead experiments or POCs to validate value and feasibility.
* Define and track key success metrics (e.g., integration uptime, incident volume/MTTR, data defect rate, batch processing times, and audit findings) and regularly report progress to stakeholders.

* Apply AI\-assisted development and troubleshooting tools (e.g., code copilots, log analyzers) to speed up integration design, debugging, and documentation while maintaining high quality.
* Analyze integration telemetry with AI/ML techniques to identify recurring failure patterns, performance bottlenecks, and opportunities for smarter alerting and auto\-remediation.


******Your Team Will:******
* Partner with People Operations, Payroll, Finance, Security, and other Business Applications teams to build and maintain the core HR technology foundation that powers the full LiveRamp employee lifecycle—from hire to retire. The team owns the Workday platform roadmap for integrations and is responsible for ensuring data flows are accurate, compliant, and resilient across our global systems landscape.
* You will join a small, highly\-collaborative group of Workday and SaaS application experts who:
* Lead key cross\-functional initiatives such as new country/entity rollouts, M\&A onboarding, org restructuring, and global HR process standardization, ensuring Workday integrations are ready to support business change.
* Provide level 2/3 application and integration support, working closely with our internal help desk and operations teams to triage issues, resolve incidents, and continuously improve the stability and usability of our FIN \& HR technology stack.
* Maintain strong partnerships with vendors and implementation partners, coordinating technical work, managing release impacts, and ensuring external integrations adhere to LiveRamp’s security and privacy requirements.
* Continuously refine our operating model, development standards, and delivery practices (Agile/iterative) so the team can ship high\-quality changes quickly while protecting a mission\-critical production environment.
* Introduce and standardize AI\-enabled practices (log summarization, impact analysis, test generation) that make it easier for the broader team to operate and evolve complex integrations.
* Partner with security, data, and platform teams to safely adopt AI capabilities that improve observability, resilience, and developer productivity in the Workday integrations space.


******About You:******
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience designing, building, and supporting Workday integrations in a production environment, using tools such as EIB, Core Connectors, Workday Studio, and Workday Web Services/REST APIs.
* Demonstrated experience owning end\-to\-end integration flows across at least two domains (e.g., HCM, Payroll, Benefits, Security, or Financials), including requirements, design, build, testing, deployment, and ongoing support.
* You are deeply curious about how systems, data, and business processes fit together, and you naturally dig into payloads, mappings, and logs rather than treating integrations as black boxes.
* You are hungry to learn and a true lifelong learner—you actively seek out new Workday integration features, patterns, and best practices, and you enjoy sharing what you learn with others.
* You are a go\-getter who takes ownership of integrations end\-to\-end, follows through on commitments, and is comfortable driving work forward without needing constant direction.
* You are an experimenter who prototypes, tests, and iterates; you’re comfortable trying new integration patterns or tooling, measuring outcomes, and quickly adjusting based on what you learn.
* You are systems\-minded and enjoy thinking in terms of interfaces, dependencies, and edge cases; you naturally anticipate downstream impacts before changing mappings or schedules in production.
* You are detail\-oriented and disciplined, especially around documentation, testing, monitoring, and change control, and you understand that small integration changes can have big, cross\-system consequences.
* You are a strong collaborator and communicator, able to translate between business language and technical behavior so stakeholders understand both the “why” and the “how” of data flows and changes.
* You are calm under pressure and comfortable troubleshooting ambiguous or complex integration issues, methodically working through hypotheses until you find and fix the root cause.
* You are service\-oriented, finding energy in helping HR, Finance, and business partners be successful through reliable integrations, high\-quality data, and thoughtful support.
* Curious about AI and automation and comfortable learning new tools (e.g., copilots, log analyzers, or analytics platforms) to boost your impact even if you haven’t used them formally before.
* Confident in asking questions, running small AI\-assisted experiments (such as log summarization, test generation, or code suggestions), and using data/AI\-generated insights to challenge the status quo and propose better, safer ways of working.


******Preferred Skills:******
* Workday Pro or Workday Integration/HCM/Financials certification(s), or equivalent advanced hands\-on experience with Workday integration tools (EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, REST/SOAP APIs) across both HCM and Financials domains.
* Experience integrating Workday with identity and access platforms (e.g., Okta / Azure AD), ATS/HR tools, payroll/benefits providers, and finance/data platforms (e.g., ERP, billing/collections, Snowflake or similar data warehouse) in a SaaS environment.
* Familiarity with other SaaS applications commonly integrated with Workday at LiveRamp, including ticketing/ITSM, HR service delivery, performance/engagement, learning, and finance\-adjacent tools (e.g., sourcing, CLM, or billing systems), and how they exchange data with Workday HCM and FINS.
* Experience with modern integration and automation tooling, ideally including an iPaaS/middleware platform such as Workato or SnapLogic, plus basic scripting (e.g., Python, PowerShell, or Shell) to support data pipelines, file transformations, and operational tasks.
* Exposure to both HR lifecycle processes (hire\-to\-retire, org changes, compensation cycles, security/role lifecycle) and finance processes (Source to Pay, Contract to Cash, GL/close), and how these translate into Workday configuration and integrations.
* Prior participation in Workday bi\-annual releases and major projects, including impact analysis on HR and FINS integrations, regression testing of critical interfaces, and rollout of new capabilities with appropriate monitoring.
* Familiarity with SOX, GDPR, and other privacy/security frameworks that impact HR and finance data, and experience designing integration\-level controls, logging, and audit evidence to support compliance across both domains.
* Experience using AI copilots or automation tools in a development or integration context (e.g., generating code snippets, test cases, or documentation) or a strong desire to ramp quickly.
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms that leverage AI/ML to detect anomalies or predict incidents across integrations and data flows.

description:

**About The Role**
 The Process Intelligence Specialist is responsible for delivering data‑driven insights into how business processes actually run, using process mining, modelling, and advanced analytics. The role focuses on hands‑on analysis, converting complex process data into clear, actionable insights that help teams improve service, cost, speed, adherence, and automation readiness. This role works closely with process leads, business operations, data analytics, transformation teams, IT, and analytics functions and plays a key role in embedding process intelligence into day‑to‑day decision‑making.
   

  

 Your responsibilities

* Support process standardization efforts while clearly highlighting justified local or channel‑specific variants
* Contribute to scenario and impact modelling (e.g. what\-if models for promotions, capacity constraints, demand shocks)
* Set\-up \& Analysis of end‑to‑end process mining use cases on end\-to\-end processes e.g., O2C, S2P, R2R, Hire\-to\-Retire, Plan\-to Fulfil
* Discover actual execution flows, variants, bottlenecks, rework, and deviations from standard processes
* Support audit, SOX, and regulatory requirements with data‑based evidence
* Help define preventive controls and leading indicators
* Translate analytical findings into clear, business‑oriented insights
* Create dashboards, views, and visuals that answer, “what happened, why, and where to act.”

 5\-7 years in process analytics, process improvement, or operational analytics
   

  

 Hands‑on experience with process intelligence tools
   

  

 Exposure to FMCG, consumer goods, or other high‑volume operational environments preferred
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in business, Data Analytics or related field
   

  

 Certifications in Lean Six Sigma, Agile working, Process Mining, Analytics are a plus
   

  

 The skills for success
   

  

 Process Mining, Celonis, Process data analysis, Business process transformation, Six Sigma, Finance Process transformaiton, Lean, Process Intelligence, Process Modelling

 Trust and Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know\-how, excellent problem\-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.
   

  

 As a T\&S Ads Scams Analyst, you will be responsible for protecting users from offline scams, which take place outside the Google Ads Platform. You will use data to provide recommendations to products and devise solutions (global and hyperlocal) to stay ahead of the fraudsters. You will also be responsible for ensuring good advertisers are provided the right opportunity to serve. As an analyst, you will use Applied AI, machine learning or other techniques to optimize human review cost and efficiency while continuously identifying enforcement gaps and automation opportunities. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to achieve your business goals and lead projects end\-to\-end.At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust and Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As an Assistant Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring the accurate and timely delivery of daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports to global stakeholders. This role requires close collaboration with cross\-functional teams including Distribution, Investment, Technology, Compliance, and Investment Services to support business objectives and maintain high service standards. Consequently, the incumbent will be strategically positioned to engage across all sub\-functions within the SIPOC framework, with an expectation to take ownership of responsibilities as they arise.
   

  

**Team Supervision**
* Allocate tasks and monitor daily workload distribution.

title: Team Leader-R
description:
**Job Description:**
**Job Description**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Job Description:**
 Possesses knowledge in a specialized function or skill gained through work experience or formal training. Supervisory role with responsibility to deliver critical to quality metrics for the lines of businesses that he/she supports. May recommend solutions to moderately complex problems, lead or train other associates and/or supervise highly routine work. Possesses leadership, communication \& problem solving skills. Typical span of control would range from 7\-12 people. May perform a specialist role in a support function performing routine transactions or functional activities. Incumbents would be Graduates / Post Graduates with 48 \- 60 months of work experience with at least 12 months experience of leading a team.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Business Information caters to research and information needs of various groups in the Bank. The primary objective of the group is to help requestor optimize time spent on Data Analysis and Client Interactions by leveraging the expertise of BI team in Data Collation. The primary customers include Global Corporate \& Investment Banking, Global Business \& Financial Services, Debt Capital Raising Administration and Enterprise Technology \& Delivery.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 Individual will be executing \& delivering high quality of business research including complex industry requests. Information will be gathered using secondary sources including syndicated sources, public domain and information sources, to effectively address business objectives. Additional responsibilities include work flow management and mentoring junior researchers.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Deliver high quality research output on all types of research requests including complex/niche industry research request
* Willingness to work in a 24\*7 (Rotational Shift) set\-up as well as on Indian holidays
* Provide next level training to upcoming researchers and guide junior researcher on complex research queries
* Ensure high quality and deadline is met on all research requests
* Ability to understand the financial and market terminologies and provide the relevant information in short notice
* Liaise with bankers to understand their requirement and to resolve quality issues
* Perform root cause analysis on negative feedbacks from Bankers
* Proficiency in Workflow Management


**Requirements\***
**Education** 
 \- Post Graduate (MBA's / Masters) degree in Finance or Business Administration
   

  

 Certifications if any \- Any certification related to research is preferred, but not mandatory
   

  

**Experience Range** 
 \- Overall experience of 5 to 7 years in Business Research/Information Research kind of teams with at least 3 years of Industry level research experience is required (Prior work flow management experience is desired)
   

  

**Foundational Skills** 
 \*
   

  

* Hands\-on experience of Industry/Market level databases such as Gartner, Wood Mackenzie, IDC, BMI, EMIS, Frost \& Sullivan, Euromonitor, SNL, Nielsen, etc.
* Advanced working knowledge on sources such as Factiva, Bloomberg, FactSet, Thomson Eikon, Capital IQ, EIU, Autex, SDC, Merger Market, VentureSource, etc. for performing News runs, Advanced Screenings, Extracting data to excel using formulae builders/excel plug\-ins, Extracting complex documents (Indentures, Credit Agreements), Country/Economy research, Trading data on Securities, Proficiency in M\&A, ECM, DCM, PIBs, etc
* Should have experience in managing workflow including assigning requests based on the knowledge level of the associate, negotiating deadlines with bankers, etc.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint including formatting, hyperlinking, deep linking techniques along with good verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work under pressure with high attention to detail and ability to maintain confidentiality


**Desired Skills\***
* Personal motivated and ability to function as a team player
* Proactive and flexible
* Strong work ethics


**Work Timings\***
 The team functions in staggered shifts with coverage starting from 6:30 am and ending at 7:30 am the next day. Working in all shifts including the night shift starting is mandatory requirement. The team provides coverage on weekends as well and hence; the prospective candidates should be flexible to work on Saturday and Sunday.
   

  

 Two Months Rotational Shifts (Including Weekend Coverage)
   

  

* 06:30 to 15:30 (Weekend Coverage 06:30 to 15:30\)
* 13:30 to 22:30 (Weekend Coverage 14:30 to 23:30\)
* 16:30 to 01:30
* 22:30 to 07:30


**Job Location\* \-** 
 Hyderabad

title: Manager Central Monitoring
description:
**Build Our Future Together**
 Regeneron is founded on the belief that the right idea, combined with the right team, can lead to significant transformations. Our growing global network is dedicated to inventing, developing, and commercializing medicines that change lives for those with serious diseases. In doing so, we are pioneering innovative approaches to science, manufacturing, and commercialization, as well as redefining our understanding of health.
   

  

 At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life\-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking a Manager, Central Monitoring, Data Analysis to join our Global Clinical Trial Services team. In this role, you will oversee centralized monitoring activities for global and complex clinical trials and support the configuration, execution, and maintenance of Risk\-Based Quality Management (RBQM) platforms. You will leverage your programming and analytical expertise to create customized analyses, automate workflows, integrate data systems, and deliver actionable insights that support informed decision\-making and optimize clinical trial performance. You may also oversee multiple studies within an assigned therapeutic area, lead process\-improvement initiatives, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams and industry partners to advance central monitoring capabilities.
   

  

**When \& Where**
 Hyderabad, India (hybrid)
   

  

**Discover Your Role**
* Act as a subject\-matter expert for the configuration, implementation, and execution of Central Monitoring RBQM platforms across studies.
* Maintain Regeneron Central Monitoring Key Risk Indicator and Quality Tolerance Limit libraries to ensure consistent deployment across studies and alignment with regulatory requirements.
* Configure studies within an RBQM platform by partnering with functional and cross\-functional stakeholders to develop Central Monitoring configuration specifications.
* Provide operational expertise, training, and guidance, serving as an escalation point for issues related to the Central Monitoring RBQM platform.
* Conduct central monitoring reviews as required, including recurring data refreshes and troubleshooting execution errors in support of Study Central Monitors.
* Apply programming expertise to support Central Monitoring data analysis, automation, reporting, and system integration.
* Interpret and present Key Risk Indicator and Key Performance Indicator data to support informed decision\-making.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement and standardization of technologies, systems, processes, and training materials that support Central Monitoring and RBQM.
* Represent Central Monitoring in process\-improvement initiatives and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Oversee multiple studies within an assigned therapeutic area, as applicable, and contribute to innovation in central monitoring capabilities.
* Travel up to 25%, as required.


**This Role Requires**
* At least 7 years of relevant biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry experience. Experience in Central Monitoring, site monitoring, or data management is preferred.
* A minimum of 2 years of direct experience with RBQM systems.
* Technical expertise in database design, system configuration, and report development, with experience managing RBQM or similar platforms.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, SQL, or SAS, with the ability to develop scripts for data analysis, automation, and system integration.
* Strong analytical, critical\-thinking, and problem\-solving skills, including experience troubleshooting data refreshes and resolving execution errors in analytical systems.
* Working knowledge of the clinical drug\-development process, including ICH and GCP guidelines and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Experience with clinical databases, electronic data\-capture systems, quality\-control processes, and auditing procedures.
* The skills for mathematical concepts, statistical methodologies, and data analytics, with the ability to interpret KRIs and KPIs.
* The ability to identify and interpret current and emerging business trends and apply them to centralized monitoring practices.
* Effective interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to convey sophisticated technical and analytical insights clearly and concisely.
* The ability to collaborate across cross\-functional teams and build effective internal and external relationships.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including sophisticated Excel skills for data manipulation and reporting.
* Experience using CluePoints or a similar centralized monitoring and risk\-based quality management solution is preferred

title: Transformation Officer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 The Transformation Officer is an intellectually curious, analytically driven role at the foundation of the Transformation Office. Working as a core member of a transformation program team, this individual supports the delivery of discrete workstreams by conducting structured business analysis, gathering and synthesising operational data, mapping processes, engaging with subject matter experts, and producing clear outputs that drive informed decision\-making and program progress.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for an early\-career professional with the mindset of a consultant — someone who is energised by problem\-solving, takes initiative to dig into the detail, and takes pride in producing high\-quality, rigorous work. The Transformation Officer will work closely alongside global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business, gaining broad exposure to the firm's operations and technology landscape while contributing meaningfully to real transformation outcomes from day one.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
**Analysis \& Research**
* Conduct structured current\-state analysis to understand existing processes, workflows, roles, and operational pain points, through interviews, workshops, and data review
* Gather, clean, and analyse quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement
* Develop and maintain process maps, data models, and analytical frameworks that underpin workstream findings and recommendations
* Analyse interdependencies between people, process, technology, and governance elements of the operating model, under the guidance of the Senior Officer or Program Lead
* Proactively research best practices, benchmarks, and comparable approaches to inform solution design
* Contribute to the development of business cases, options papers, and other analytical outputs that inform senior decision\-making


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Requirements Gathering**
* Engage day\-to\-day with global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business to gather information, validate analysis, and support the change process
* Support the facilitation of workshops and interviews with stakeholders across functions to capture requirements, surface pain points, and gather input
* Assist in translating business needs into clear, structured requirements and user stories for technology and process workstreams
* Support change impact assessments and stakeholder mapping activities
* Build constructive working relationships with subject matter experts and operational counterparts across the business
* Communicate findings and workstream updates clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing, in a manner appropriate to the audience


**Technology\-Enabled Transformation**
* Support work with Global Process Owners, Tech, Product, and Operations teams to understand technology solutions and their implications for the operating model
* Contribute to the definition of functional requirements and business logic for tech\-enabled tools, workflows, and automation opportunities
* Develop an active awareness of AI and agentic AI tools and their potential to create value within transformation workstreams, in line with Alter Domus's AI governance framework
* Assist in ensuring alignment between business processes and system capabilities, flagging gaps and inconsistencies for resolution


**Workstream Support \& Delivery**
* Support the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned workstreams, taking ownership of defined tasks and deliverables within the broader program plan
* Maintain up\-to\-date workstream documentation, including process maps, trackers, issue logs, and meeting notes
* Assist with data analysis, reporting, and insights to inform program governance and decision\-making
* Participate in testing, user acceptance, and validation activities to ensure solutions meet business needs
* Identify and escalate risks, blockers, and dependencies promptly, with an initial view on potential solutions
* Demonstrate a self\-starter attitude — proactively progressing work without waiting for direction, and consistently delivering to a high standard


**Change Management \& Documentation**
* Support the design and delivery of change activities, including communications, training materials, and readiness assessments
* Help identify change resistance and contribute to strategies that build engagement and adoption across impacted teams
* Produce clear, well\-structured documentation of current\-state and future\-state processes, including standard operating procedures (SOPs), playbooks, and knowledge assets to enable smooth transition to new ways of working
* Contribute to knowledge transfer activities and ensure workstream outputs are thoroughly recorded and accessible for BAU teams


**Essential**
**Skills \& Experience Required:**
* 3\-4 years of professional experience in management consulting, business analysis, operations, financial services, or a related analytical field; exceptional recent graduates will also be considered
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills — able to structure problems clearly, analyse data rigorously, and draw well\-reasoned conclusions
* High attention to detail with a commitment to producing accurate, high\-quality work
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information in a structured and compelling way
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to build clean models and well\-structured presentations
* A proactive, self\-starting mindset — intellectually curious, eager to learn, and comfortable taking initiative in ambiguous situations
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* High levels of personal drive, ownership, and accountability


**Desirable**
* Domain knowledge in one or more of the following:
+ Fund Administration (e.g., NAV production, investor reporting, transfer agency, custody operations, or related middle/back\-office processes)
+ Financial Services Technology (e.g., platforms, infrastructure, system implementations, or digital transformation)
+ AI Enablement (e.g., GenAI adoption, process automation, AI\-assisted workflows, or data\-driven transformation)

* Sound understanding of how regulated financial services entities operate, with some exposure to fund administration, private equity, alternative investments, or wealth management
* Exposure to regulatory change programmes or compliance\-driven transformation
* Experience with service design, customer journey mapping, or lean/six sigma methodologies
* Prior exposure to process improvement, project delivery, or transformation activity in any context (professional or academic)
* Familiarity with process mapping or collaboration tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, Confluence, Jira)

description:

 Risk and Compliance Monitoring team (RCMT) is the centralized, architectural subject matter expert for Amazon Surface Transportation, including ROC, Amazon Transportation Services (ATS), and Amazon Logistics (AMZL).This team leads risk assessments across ST programs and develops tailored risk mitigation initiatives, programs, and audits to meet the needs of our business customers. RCMT is dedicated to preventing bad actors from exploiting Amazon services for illicit purposes and collaborates closely with legal, finance, and HR departments to conduct thorough investigations and take necessary actions against such actors. Our overarching vision is to ensure that bad actors never derive any benefit from Amazon by exploiting our policies. To achieve this, RCMT relies on sound judgment, technical expertise, and a robust risk management framework. We harness advanced technology to enhance our processes and develop projects, programs, and products that optimize Surface Transportation Operations.
   

  

* The role operates on a rotational shift model (including nights and rotational weekoffs) to provide round\-the\-clock risk coverage across time zones.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Apply risk\-management best practices/methodologies to mitigate the risk issues you manage, to improve risk\-related processes, and to help resolve blocking problems
* Develop appropriate milestones and launch project schedules to ensure timely and successful delivery of a project and standard work (e.g., audits/reviews, licensing).
* Identifies gaps in controls and processes and Consult legal for guidance on specific use cases or escalations based on manager direction
* Seek guidance to ensure your program stays aligned with the risk strategy, regulations, policies, and team objectives.
* Understand the business needs and/or workflows owned by your team (e.g., financial risk, controls, escalation paths, data sources, metrics, testing mechanisms, key dependencies, any automation/tools, risk\-assessment methodologies). This may include understanding internal and external policies and/or contracts used by partner teams.
* Executes against established SOPs and identifies and recommends opportunities for process improvement. Observes and escalates gaps in processes or controls and recommend/draft SOP revisions
* Performs deep dive analysis and drafts COE based on identified deviations and recommends appropriate solutions.
* Owns weekly/monthly metrics and process reviews with internal and external stakeholders
* Maintains subject matter expertise specific to job functions and general industry awareness
* Earns trust of peers by understanding operational processes related to risk management programs and product offerings
* Mentors peers and new hires and may participate in the development and delivery of risk management training
* Provide recommendation to manager improvements to technical risk management solutions to drive program efficiencies


**Basic Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of program or project management experience
* 1\+ years of supply chain experience
* 2\+ Years experience with project/program management working with cross\-functional teams
* 2\+ years experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
* Experience in Supply chain Management

description:

 The Role
   

  

 Help us transform and bring innovation to Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance!
   

  

 Veeva is looking for Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance experts to join the Professional Services team and support implementations of our Vault Safety solution. We want innovative thinkers with deep domain expertise who are ready to challenge the status quo with new technology.
   

  

 As a key member of our Professional Services team, the Consultant \- Safety will work side\-by\-side with customers and our senior consultants and solution Architects to implement Vault Safety. In this role, the candidate will support the overall delivery of Vault Safety for our customers. They will define and drive business processes, support the project team in delivering the solution, and guide our customers throughout the implementation programs.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Support life sciences customers in the rapid configuration and implementation of Vault Safety.
* Execute workshops and lead customer discussions of the Vault Development Cloud.
* Lead gap analyses, workshop preparation and delivery, requirements gathering, configuration, validation, and customer training.
* Gather customer functional and technical requirements to support business processes; translate requirements into system configuration.
* Provide subject matter expertise on Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance for customers and project teams.
* Represent Safety Professional Services across multiple engagements and workstreams (e.g. solution design and configuration, data migration, systems integration, etc.).
* Ensure customer success from beginning to end of the engagement life cycle.
* Provide Argus / Aris data model expertise in migrating customers’ existing data into Vault safety.


**Requirements**
* 3\+ years of life sciences industry experience, with the majority of time spent in the Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance domain and experience in a consulting function.
* Knowledge of Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance processes and regulations.
* Must have decent experience writing complex SQL queries on safety data sets.
* Should have worked on implementing safety systems like Aris / Argus / Emperica / Commonwealth / RxLogix / or any homegrown safety system
* Proven ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders and ensure delivery to a high degree of satisfaction.
* Good to have experience building aggregate and analytical reports on safety data set.
* Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Must have worked in an individual contributor capacity in previous employment.

title: Associate, Membership – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN)
description:
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
 At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
   

  

 Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As a
 **Senior Associate, Membership – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN)** 
 , you will support the execution of U.S. pharmaceutical Membership operations by managing customer eligibility, GPO alignments, membership validations, customer setup, contract alignment, and membership maintenance activities. You will serve as a critical link between Market Access, Contracting, Pricing, Chargebacks, MDM, Government Pricing, wholesalers, GPOs, and customers to ensure accurate customer eligibility and contract execution across the Amgen commercial contracting landscape. The role supports the end\-to\-end Membership process from receipt of customer requests through validation, setup, system alignment, and ongoing maintenance.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
*Membership Operations \& Customer Eligibility*
* Support the end\-to\-end membership process including customer onboarding, eligibility validation, membership maintenance, GPO alignments, and customer relationship updates.
* Review and triage incoming membership requests received through the Membership mailbox from GPOs, wholesalers, Key Account Managers (KAMs), Contracting teams, and other stakeholders.
* Validate customer information submitted through Declaration (DEC) Forms, rosters, and customer requests to ensure completeness and compliance with contractual requirements.
* Determine customer eligibility based on contract terms, class of trade (COT), GPO participation, and business\-specific membership requirements.
* Support execution against established service level agreements (SLAs) and communicate status updates or delays to stakeholders as needed.


*Customer Validation \& Membership Maintenance*
* Perform customer validation activities utilizing HIN, DEA, HIBCC, HRSA, OneKey, HCM, GCPS, and other approved reference sources.
* Review Declaration (DEC) Forms for accuracy, completeness, valid signatures, proper customer identifiers, and current forms before processing.
* Validate parent\-child relationships, legal entity hierarchies (LEH), customer attributes, and customer master data prior to customer setup.
* Maintain membership records, customer alignments, contract affiliations, and GPO relationships within approved systems.
* Support customer adds, drops, strategy realignments, and membership updates resulting from acquisitions, organizational changes, roster updates, and contract transitions.


*Customer Setup \& Systems Management*
* Create and maintain customer records within HCM, GCPS, SAP, and related systems supporting commercial contract operations.
* Support customer onboarding activities including customer setup, LEH creation, customer attribute maintenance, and contract alignment.
* Coordinate with MDM teams to support customer record creation, updates, master data corrections, and hierarchy management.
* Monitor and validate system interfaces between HCM, SAP, GCPS, and related applications to ensure successful data synchronization.
* Investigate and resolve customer setup, interface, and data integrity issues impacting contract eligibility and pricing access.


*Membership Reporting \& Eligibility Management*
* Develop, validate, and distribute eligibility reports supporting GPOs, wholesalers, Market Access teams, and other stakeholders.
* Perform ongoing review of dispute reports and customer listings to identify missing, misaligned, or new customers requiring setup or updates.
* Support customer eligibility validations related to contract participation, GPO membership, specialty pharmacy programs, hospital coalitions, and other business\-specific arrangements
* Analyze membership trends, customer changes, roster updates, and operational metrics to support business decisions and improve data quality.


*Rebuttals, Dispute Resolution \& Stakeholder Support*
* Investigate customer eligibility disputes and support rebuttal activities with GPOs and external stakeholders.
* Review denial requests, perform customer eligibility research, prepare supporting rationale, and maintain appropriate documentation of decisions.
* Collaborate with Membership leadership, Contracting, Pricing, Chargebacks, Government Pricing, and external customers to resolve membership\-related inquiries and issues.
* Maintain complete documentation and audit trails supporting membership decisions, customer alignments, and eligibility determinations.


*PHS, 340B \& Specialized Membership Programs*
* Support quarterly Public Health Service (PHS) and 340B eligibility updates, customer validation activities, and contract maintenance processes.
* Review OPA extracts and support additions, removals, and maintenance of 340B eligibility indicators and customer attributes
* Support hospital coalition pricing reviews, validation of coalition participation, and eligibility assessments.
* Assist with specialty pharmacy, Kaiser, IBU, OBU, Tezspire, and other membership program\-specific processes and customer validations.


*Compliance, Controls \& Audit Readiness*
* Ensure compliance with SOX controls, internal policies, pricing governance requirements, audit standards, and applicable pharmaceutical contracting regulations


*Compliance, Controls \& Continuous Improvement*
* Execute work in accordance with SOX controls, internal policies, pricing governance requirements, audit standards, and pharmaceutical contracting expectations.
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation supporting customer setup, eligibility reviews, approvals, and membership updates.
* Support audit requests, control testing, operational reviews, and compliance activities.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, improve data quality, reduce cycle times, and enhance customer setup efficiency.
* Participate in UAT, system enhancements, reporting improvements, and process optimization initiatives.


**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The ideal candidate is a detail\-oriented commercial operations professional with experience supporting customer master data, membership operations, customer eligibility, contract administration, pricing operations, or related pharmaceutical business processes. This individual should bring strong analytical skills, customer focus, stakeholder collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset to ensure accurate and compliant membership execution.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in business administration, Finance, Commerce, Economics, Life Sciences, Healthcare Administration, or related discipline.
* 3–6 years of experience in pharmaceutical commercial operations, membership operations, contracts \& pricing, customer master data, managed markets, market access, revenue management, or related business functions
* Experience supporting customer validation, contract administration, data management, reporting, or operational processes.
* Strong Excel, analytical, organizational, and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a deadline\-driven environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry experience.
* Knowledge of U.S. pharmaceutical customer eligibility, membership operations, GPO contracting, market access, and reimbursement processes.
* Experience with HCM, GCPS, SAP, Tableau, OneKey, HIBCC, HRSA, Model N, or similar commercial operations platforms.
* Understanding of customer master data management, legal entity hierarchies, parent\-child relationships, class of trade management, and contract eligibility processes.
* Experience supporting customer onboarding, data governance, compliance controls, and audit activities.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience collaborating with U.S.\-based stakeholders in a global operating model.

title: Sr Manager, Security Analytics & Operations Senior (PL)
description:
Your opportunity
   

  

 At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
   

  

 Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region.
   

  

 The SOC Manager is the leader and program manager of the Security Operations Center, responsible for overseeing the entire 24/7 SOC program from a strategic and managerial level. This role ensures that the SOC’s people, processes, and technologies work in unison to detect and respond to cybersecurity threats effectively, especially critical in a high\-stakes financial environment where customer trust and regulatory compliance are paramount. The SOC Manager defines the SOC’s strategy and operating procedures, aligns the team’s objectives with the organization’s risk management and business goals, and communicates the SOC’s status and needs to executive leadership. In a financial industry context, the SOC Manager also plays a key role in ensuring compliance with industry regulations (such as PCI\-DSS or FFIEC guidelines) through well\-documented processes and by coordinating with risk and compliance teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Strategic Direction: Develop and drive the SOC’s strategy and roadmap. Define the scope of the SOC’s services (e.g., which threats to monitor, which assets to protect) in alignment with the organization’s business objectives and risk appetite. Regularly assess and update this strategy to address evolving cyber threats, new business initiatives, and changes in regulatory requirements.
* Team Leadership \& Development: Build and manage the SOC team to ensure 24/7 operational coverage and high performance. Oversee recruitment, training, and professional development of SOC personnel (analysts and team leads). Establish clear performance goals and career progression paths for team members, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and strong teamwork. Provide coaching and conduct performance evaluations.
* Operational Oversight: Oversee daily SOC operations and ensure the incident response program is functioning effectively at all times. Verify that the SOC is appropriately staffed, and that incident response playbooks and processes are well\-documented, tested, and adhered to during incidents. Organize regular drills or simulations (like cyber incident tabletop exercises) to test and improve the team’s readiness for various attack scenarios.
* Metrics \& Reporting: Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for the SOC, such as Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Mean Time to Respond (MTTR), incident volume trends, and analyst efficiency. Use metrics to gauge the SOC’s effectiveness and identify areas for improvement. Prepare and deliver regular reports and executive summaries highlighting the SOC’s activities, major incidents, and value delivered (e.g., threats detected and prevented) to senior management and other stakeholders. Communicate the organization’s security posture in business terms, translating technical details into risk and impact language that executives can understand.
* Process Improvement \& Technology: Continuously improve SOC processes and technology stack. Champion the integration of advanced security tools and automation to streamline operations (for instance, deploying a SOAR platform to automate repetitive tasks and orchestrate incident response actions). Evaluate and implement new security monitoring solutions or threat intelligence services to enhance detection capabilities.
* Regularly review and update incident response playbooks and SOPs for efficiency and relevance.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with peer teams and stakeholders across the organization. Work closely with IT infrastructure teams, application owners, compliance and legal departments, fraud investigation units, and others to ensure a unified approach to security. For example, collaborate with the Threat Intelligence team to ingest relevant threat intel into the SOC, or with Compliance/Legal in the event an incident has regulatory reporting implications. Foster strong communication channels so that the SOC is aware of upcoming changes (new systems, major business initiatives) and can adapt its monitoring appropriately.
* Risk \& Compliance Management: Ensure SOC activities meet regulatory and compliance requirements. In the financial sector, this includes maintaining robust audit trails of incidents, adhering to data privacy laws, and possibly reporting certain incidents to regulators. Develop and enforce policies and procedures that align with frameworks/standards (like NIST CSF, ISO 27001\) and industry regulations. Support internal and external audits by providing evidence of SOC controls and effectiveness.


 What you have
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Experience: 7–10\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with several years in a leadership role managing security operations or incident response teams. A background that includes climbing the ranks (e.g., from analyst to senior/lead) is ideal, as it provides both hands\-on technical experience and insight into effective SOC processes. Experience in the financial services industry or other large enterprises is highly valuable, given the scope and regulatory environment.
* Leadership \& Management Skills: Proven experience in leading and developing teams. This includes setting objectives, performance management, and mentoring. The SOC Manager should have experience managing a team with 24/7 responsibilities and an understanding of how to maintain team morale and effectiveness in a high\-pressure environment. Strong project management skills to drive initiatives (such as tool deployments or new process rollouts) from concept to completion.
* Technical Knowledge: Broad and deep understanding of security technologies and operations. Expertise with SIEM, EDR, and other incident response tools from an administrative/management perspective (e.g., ensuring proper deployment and health of these systems). Familiarity with network architecture, system administration, and security best practices across on\-premises and cloud environments. While the SOC Manager may not be involved in day\-to\-day analysis, they should be capable of understanding technical issues encountered by the team and providing guidance or resources.
* Strategic and Business Acumen: Ability to develop security operations strategies that align with business needs and risk management goals. This includes knowledge of risk assessment methodologies and understanding of how cybersecurity incidents can impact business operations, finances, and reputation. The SOC Manager should be adept at justifying investments in the SOC through metrics and business cases (e.g., demonstrating how improved detection and response reduces potential financial loss).
* Certifications: Security management or leadership certifications are strongly preferred, such as CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) or CISM (Certified Information Security Manager). These indicate a solid grasp of security governance, program management, and risk management. Relevant technical certifications at the expert level (e.g., GIAC GSLC/GSED, or vendor\-specific expert certifications) can also underscore the candidate’s technical credibility. An MBA or master’s degree in cybersecurity/information assurance can be a plus, reflecting further leadership and business training.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Financial Industry Expertise: Prior experience working in or with financial institutions’ security operations, acknowledging the unique threat landscape (e.g., fraud, insider threats, nation\-state actors) and stringent regulatory requirements (such as SOC audits, SOX, PCI, GLBA). Understanding of financial industry compliance and audit standards is extremely beneficial.
* Change Management \& Scaling Experience: Demonstrated success in scaling and maturing a SOC – for instance, having expanded a team, introduced new tiers, or improved a SOC from a basic operation to an advanced one. Experience leading organizational change (new processes, technology rollouts, or restructuring) in a security context is a strong plus.
* Innovation: A track record of implementing automation, machine learning, or other innovative solutions in security operations to improve efficiency and effectiveness. For example, deploying a new SOAR system or integrating advanced analytics into the SOC workflow.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Proven ability to work with and present to senior leadership (CISO, CIO, risk officers) and potentially external regulators or auditors. Comfort in providing assurance about the organization’s security posture and justifying SOC needs (budget, staffing) at the executive level.


 What’s in it for you
   

  

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long\-term financial security.
   

  

**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**
* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check\-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day\-to\-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

* Experience in mining, mining services, technical services, commercial support, account management, planning, business analysis, or customer\-facing roles is advantageous.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret operational and commercial data.

* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and confidence working with data, reporting, and performance metrics.
* Experience with SAP, ERP systems, Power BI, or similar business systems is advantageous.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* A proactive mindset and willingness to build a career at the intersection of operations, customer engagement, and commercial performance.

 As part of a truly global company, you will have the ability to grow and learn in a diverse, collaborative culture. We foster relationships and learning through connected global and local teams, promote flexible and diverse career paths and support the development of your knowledge and skills.

title: Project Control Specialist II
description:
**About Us**
 Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. ***As a Project Control Specialist II with Worley,***
 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
   

  

* Lead and guide the Project Controls team for Schedule and Cost function on the Project.
* Work with Project leadership team in alignment and strategic discussions on the project.
* Develop and finalise the Project Controls Plan as per Project requirements and interface with Client and internal stakeholders.
* Lead and develop the Progress measurement system for the project based on the contractual reporting requirements and processes.

* Conduct / lead Schedule workshops, IAP sessions and focus discussions on Schedule baselining and forecast exercises as required.

* Interact with Project and department stakeholders in functional discussions and support required in delivering the Projects assigned.
* Preparation and analysis of Project performance statistics and analytics as appropriate.
* Lead to set up Project Cost reports, internal monitoring metrics and other reporting requirements.
* Monitoring \& controlling the cost by various analysis and time to time information Management about the risk areas.
* Performing Risk Analysis on the Schedule and provide inputs / recommendations.
* Generating various reports like Progress S\-curves, Lookahead Plan, Variance Analysis, Productivity Analysis.
* Invoicing, preparing Cash flow and presenting in the APEX monthly level meeting.
* Daily/Weekly/Monthly reports
* Attend Internal and Client review meetings as required to present the Project performance, Concerns, and recovery plans etc.
* Work closely with the Project and Engineering managers to ensure proactive approach on addressing project performance and recovery measures all times.
* Mentor and guide junior team members and impart knowledge transfer time to time.
* Participate internal innovative forums and contribute for the Digital growth in project delivery wherever possible.
* Preparation of project cost reports and provide forecast analysis and trends of the project.
* Liaise effectively with multidisciplinary teams, fostering collaborative relationships, and ensuring alignment between planning, execution, and project objectives.


**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
   

  

* Tertiary qualifications in Graduate in Engineering/Technology.
* 8\+ years of experience in Working for similar type Projects/Industry experience.
* Proven leadership and communication skills
* Extensive experience in Oil \& Gas, energy sector \& Chemicals.
* Sound knowledge of Planning, Cost control and Monitoring.
* A dedication to client satisfaction
* Excellent relationship building and stakeholder management skills.
* You will be an enthusiastic team player, with excellent stakeholder management skills.
* Proactive thinking and solution\-oriented delivery.


**Moving forward together**
 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
   

  

 And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 Help us maximize the value of our software contracts while minimizing compliance risk across a global portfolio. You'll partner across teams to turn data into proactive actions ahead of renewals and negotiations.

 As a Software Asset Optimization Owner (Associate) in Enterprise Software Management at JP Morgan Chase within Infrastructure Platforms, you manage global software assets, including license compliance against contractual rights and obligations, request fulfillment, maintenance renewals, contract negotiations, chargeback, global software catalog management, license key administration, and related processes and data governance.
   

  

 You help us stay strategic and proactive by identifying optimization opportunities and coordinating work across groups to maximize contract value while minimizing risk.
   

  

 You also contribute to financial forecasting and budget planning for the software contracts we manage by partnering with teams such as Sourcing, Finance, and the Product Owner.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Manage software licensing, contracts, and inventory, including researching and interpreting licensing models/terms and contract structures across major vendors (e.g., Microsoft, IBM, Oracle, Broadcom, SAP, Adobe) and other publishers
* Create and deliver software compliance reporting, including trends and insights to support cost control, pre\-audit readiness, and ongoing compliance
* Maintain accurate software and contract records across repositories and license management systems; monitor changes and assess/communicate downstream impacts
* Perform periodic internal compliance audits to reconcile entitlements (licenses purchased/rights granted) against deployments and consumption across physical and virtual environments, software\-as\-a\-service platforms, and third\-party cloud environments
* Partner with software product owners to determine strategy, optimize usage ahead of maintenance renewals and contract negotiations, and avoid unnecessary costs; support financial forecasting and budget planning for assigned contracts
* Coordinate with product owners, Vendor Management, Sourcing, and Legal to identify and remediate license gaps when consumption exceeds contractual entitlements
* Collaborate with the Software Discovery team to ensure discovery tools accurately and comprehensively detect software usage for assigned publishers; identify work, assign dates, follow up to ensure success, and drive optimal outcomes for internal customers
* Uses enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to speed up incident triage and trend analysis from operational signals, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements.
* Applies reuse\-first, AI\-assisted practices within incident/problem/change routines to identify recurring interruption patterns and support validated remediation actions aligned to resiliency and security expectations.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* 5\+ years of experience managing software assets across on\-premises, software\-as\-a\-service, and/or public cloud environments
* Experience with software asset management tools such as USU, Flexera, ServiceNow, or SamPro
* Experience reading, interpreting, and operationalizing software license agreements and contract terms (including entitlements, use rights, restrictions, and audit clauses)
* Experience creating compliance reporting and performing internal compliance audits/reconciliations (entitlements vs. deployments/consumption)
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ability to synthesize complex data into clear, concise insights
* Familiarity with software discovery tools (e.g., Application Discovery and Dependency Mapping, System Center Configuration Manager, Altiris) and/or inventory/configuration management database systems
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple teams to execute project goals; strong written and verbal communication skills
* Demonstrated experience using enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support production support workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
* Ability to review and validate AI\-assisted incident recommendations before action, escalating when uncertain and following operational and security expectations.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Software Asset Management certifications from a recognized training provider
* Customer service mindset with a track record of delivering sustained high performance and customer satisfaction
* Ability to work well under pressure and interact effectively with varying levels of management
* Demonstrated ability to handle confidential information and communications appropriately

title: Portal Data Analyst
description:
JSM is seeking a contract Data Quality Analyst to help us raise the quality of the data underpinning our product. Data quality directly affects the reliability, security, usability, and trustworthiness of what we deliver to our users, and data accumulated over the past 9 years has eroded some data quality. This role will focus on projects and customer accounts that have been non\-functional for five years or more, yet they — along with their dependent data — that persist in our active systems. The introduction of a new ERP system provides more opportunities to clean data related to customers and their access. We need an expert who can extract data from existing databases, use various fields and queries to identify functional areas and dormant data, determine what can be archived or removed, and more broadly make recommendations to improve overall data quality and maintenance practices. Working alongside the Product Owner and functional stakeholders, this role will assess the current state of our data, diagnose the root causes of quality issues, and recommend the right set of improvements — from identifying and retiring obsolete data to normalization, standardization, de\-duplication, and correction. This is a business\-outcome driven role: the objective is to have measurably better, leaner, more trustworthy product data. Familiarity with Maximo, Windchill, or the marine/maritime domain is a strong advantage.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Identify dormant and obsolete data. Find functional areas that have been inactive for extended periods — five years or more — and map the dependent data tied to them, so we know exactly what can be safely archived or removed.
* Understand our product data. Study the data that powers our product — across primary and related data sets — and build a clear picture of its structure, relationships, and dependencies.
* Tell us where we stand. Assess data quality against the dimensions that matter to us — accuracy, completeness, consistency, uniqueness, validity, and integrity — and give us an honest, evidence\-based view of the current state.
* Find the root cause, not just the symptom. Explain why quality issues recur, so we can fix the source, not just the surface.
* Define what "good" looks like. Help the product team establish data quality standards and success measures we can hold ourselves to.
* Recommend the right improvements. For each issue, prescribe the appropriate remedy — archival or removal of obsolete data, normalization / restructuring, de\-duplication, standardization, correction, or enrichment — with clear rationale, business impact, and priority.
* Protect what depends on the data. Map how our data relates across tables and systems so that any archival, removal, or improvement preserves integrity and doesn't disrupt downstream product behavior or reporting.
* Show the improvement. Define quality metrics and demonstrate measurable before\-and\-after improvement.
* Help us sustain quality. Recommend the rules, validations, and standards that keep quality from degrading again after the engagement ends.
* Leave us self\-sufficient. Document findings, decisions, and improvement logic so the product team can carry the work forward.


**What You Will Need:**
 Education \& Experience
   

  

* Graduate with Min of 9 years of experience as Data Quality Analyst
* Experience in Marine Industry will be an added advantage


**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
* Proven track record improving data quality for a product, platform, or enterprise system.
* Experience identifying obsolete, dormant, or redundant data and defining safe archival / removal approaches.
* Exceptional attention to detail, with the discipline to spot subtle data inconsistencies, trace dependencies carefully, and validate findings before recommending changes.
* Strong grasp of data quality dimensions and the ability to translate them into terms the product team and business stakeholders understand.
* Solid understanding of how data is structured and related — normalization principles and dependency mapping across primary and related data sets.
* Sound judgement on which remedy fits which problem, balancing effort against business value.
* Ability to profile and analyze data independently and turn findings into clear, prioritized recommendations.
* A consultative, product\-minded approach — comfortable advising stakeholders, framing trade\-offs, and driving decisions.
* Ability to work independently and ramp up quickly with minimal supervision.


**Good to Have**
* Working knowledge of IBM Maximo (asset / EAM data) or PTC Windchill (PLM data).
* Familiarity with the marine, maritime, or classification\-society domain.
* Experience with master data management (MDM), data governance, or data quality frameworks.

This includes platform upgrades, modernization, and managing integrations (e.g., storage integrations, AI assistants).

* Agile \& SDLC Solid experience working on Agile teams (Scrum framework, JIRA) with a deep understanding of rigorous Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) processes, ideally within a regulated (Pharma/Healthcare) environment.

* Education \& Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, with 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in platform engineering and IT infrastructure projects.

* Deep knowledge of containerization platforms and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

* Familiarity with integrating modern AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) into data science workflows.

We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Project Controls, Engineering Analytics \& Bid Review will be based in AIN and will be part of the Project Controls organization within Amgen Engineering. This role will report to the Senior Manager – Capital Equipment Analytics and will support capital equipment analytics and bid review activities across global capital projects.
   

  

 This role will combine project controls, analytics, reporting, and capital equipment bid review experience to improve cost visibility, supplier comparison, equipment demand insights, and decision support. The Project Controls Analytics role will help structure bid information, analyse supplier proposals, support benchmarking, and develop analytics outputs that improve project planning, equipment delivery visibility, and risk identification.
   

  

 The role will also support compliance to established project controls, procurement, and reporting processes by maintaining reliable data, clear analytical assumptions, and audit\-ready supporting documentation.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
* Support capital equipment bid review, including cost comparison, schedule / lead\-time review, scope completeness, assumptions, exclusions, and risk indicators.
* Support benchmarking by comparing current bids against historical project and equipment data to identify cost trends, variance drivers, supplier differences, and forecasting inputs.
* Support reporting, analytics, and decision\-support tools that improve visibility into equipment demand, spend, bid comparisons, supplier risks, delivery milestones, and lifecycle status.
* Support the equipment data foundation by collecting, validating, and maintaining bid, supplier, cost, demand, schedule, delivery, and lifecycle data.
* Maintain audit\-ready analysis files, data records, assumptions, and supporting documentation in alignment with established project controls and procurement processes.
* Use digital, automation, and AI\-enabled tools to improve analysis quality, reporting efficiency, data review, and insight generation.
* Partner with Project Controls, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, and project teams to gather inputs, validate assumptions, and align analytical outputs.
* Support bid review templates, reporting standards, analytics methods, and data quality practices.


**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent).
* 5–9 years of work experience in Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field
* Experience in the global pharmaceutical industry preferred.


**Functional Skills**
* Project controls and analytics experience in a capital project, engineering, procurement, or estimating environment.
* Support bid review, cost comparison, benchmarking, forecasting, reporting, or supplier proposal analysis.
* Ability to review capital equipment bids and interpret cost, scope, schedule, assumptions, exclusions, delivery risks, and comparison points.
* Experience with digital tools for reporting and analytics such as Power BI, advanced Excel, SAP, procurement / sourcing systems, data structuring, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of data integrity, process compliance, documentation discipline, and audit readiness in project controls, analytics, or procurement\-related workflows.
* Understanding of capital project cost, schedule, procurement, and supplier delivery information.
* Ability to partner effectively with Engineering, Project Controls, Procurement, Finance, and project teams.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills:**
* Experience supporting capital projects in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, advanced manufacturing, or other regulated industries.
* Experience working with capital equipment, supplier bids, procurement data, or equipment lifecycle information.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled productivity and analytics tools such as ChatGPT, Codex, VS Code extensions, or similar tools.
* Experience developing bid review templates, reporting standards, data models, or analytical tools.
* Familiarity with automation, advanced analytics, data quality improvement, or scalable reporting practices.

* Relevant certification in project management, project controls, cost management, analytics, engineering, or a related discipline
