description:
**Business Analyst, Officer, Interfaces**
****Job Description****
**What we are looking for**
 We are seeking a
 **Business Analyst** 
 responsible for bridging business, product, and technology teams to deliver innovative solutions across Charles River Investment Management System (IMS) and related front, middle, and back\-office workflows. This role plays a critical part in defining product capabilities, gathering and documenting requirements, validating functionality, and ensuring the successful delivery of solutions that meet client and business needs.
   

  

 The Business Analyst will become a subject matter expert in Charles River products and investment workflows, partnering closely with clients, product managers, engineers, quality assurance, and implementation teams throughout the software development lifecycle. Working within a feature\-focused Agile team, they will leverage both financial industry expertise and technical knowledge to analyze complex business processes, define functional requirements, troubleshoot issues, and drive enhancements that improve the overall client experience.
   

  

 This role requires a combination of strong analytical skills, financial market knowledge, technical aptitude, and the ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders. The successful candidate will be comfortable operating in a fast\-paced environment, managing multiple priorities, and independently driving initiatives from concept through delivery.
   

  

**Why this job is important to us**
 Charles River Development brings together data and capabilities across the investment lifecycle to help our clients make better decisions, grow at scale, and deliver returns for their clients. Our diverse team of highly skilled technologists and professionals are agile thinkers and problem solvers, committed to our end users and engineering excellence. We use mentorship and teamwork to impact and drive our business forward every day.
   

  

 By joining the Charles River Product Development team, you will work at the intersection of financial technology and investment management, helping shape products that power some of the world's largest asset managers, asset owners, and financial institutions. You will collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to deliver innovative solutions that streamline investment operations, improve data accuracy, and enable better investment decisions.
   

  

 At Charles River Development (CRD), we've been creating some of the most insightful and sophisticated investment management technologies since 1997\. Through our commitment to product quality and client success, we've experienced continuous growth. Charles River IMS is strategically aligned to innovate the future of investment management technologies. Together with State Street's middle and back\-office capabilities, Charles River's cloud\-deployed software technology forms the foundation of State Street Alpha℠.
   

  

****Responsibilities:****
**What you are responsible for**
* Apply detailed knowledge of business requirements, investment workflows, and operational processes to support product development initiatives.
* Research, analyze, and produce comprehensive business and technical requirement documents.
* Analyze middle\-office and back\-office investment management workflows and create detailed functional specifications.
* Work directly with clients and product management teams to gather business requirements and develop product feature specifications.
* Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering through implementation and validation.
* Partner closely with engineering teams to design, develop, implement, and refine product capabilities.
* Plan and coordinate validation activities, perform hands\-on functional testing, and develop verification plans and processes.
* Provide feedback on product functionality, usability, and performance to help drive continuous improvement.
* Review product documentation and ensure complete, accurate, and high\-quality deliverables.
* Support client beta programs and assist in training users on new product capabilities and releases.
* Assist in managing project schedules, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies.
* Collaborate with implementation and support teams to troubleshoot, reproduce, and resolve escalated client issues.
* Participate actively in the Agile software development process, including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Assist with Jira work item creation, refinement, prioritization, and tracking.
* Participate in integration testing activities and environment setup as required.
* Work closely with Quality Assurance teams to review and approve test plans, test cases, and validation results.
* Coordinate across engineering, QA, support, implementation, and product management teams to ensure successful and timely product releases.
* Identify risks, dependencies, and potential implementation challenges, proactively driving resolution to maintain project momentum.


****Requirements:****
* 10\+ years of experience working within the software development lifecycle, preferably in Agile environments.
* Strong experience analyzing investment management workflows, particularly middle\-office functions including position and tax lot reconciliation.
* Familiarity with financial instruments including equities, fixed income, foreign exchange, derivatives, and related asset classes.
* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, including negotiation and stakeholder management.
* Advanced writing skills with the ability to abstract and summarize highly detailed technical and business information.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to reconcile conflicting requirements and data sources.
* Ability to translate business needs into detailed functional and technical requirements.
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to collaborate effectively with software engineering teams.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL); familiarity with ETL technologies such as Kettle or Talend is a plus.
* Demonstrated planning, organization, and scheduling skills.
* Ability to independently learn new domains, remove obstacles, and proactively drive progress.
* Curiosity and interest in financial markets, trading, and investment management technology.
* Proven ability to produce comprehensive business, functional, and technical specification documents.
* Experience working directly with clients to gather requirements and validate solutions.
* Knowledge of one or more Charles River functional areas is strongly preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Education: BS Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or study of Business with an MIS background. MS/MBA degree strongly preferred

 State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. title: Analyst Data & Insight
description:
**Overview**
 Founded in 1988, Trimont (www.trimont.com) is a specialized global commercial real estate loan services provider and partner for lenders and investors seeking the infrastructure and capabilities needed to help them scale their business and make informed, effective decisions related to the deployment, management and administration of commercial real estate secured credit. As the largest master servicer of commercial real estate loans in the United States, Trimont manages securitizations with meticulous oversight and coordination—protecting cash flows, mitigating risk, and ensuring portfolio performance.
   

  

 We do this with a team of 1100\+ extraordinary team members who serve a global client base from offices in Atlanta (headquarters), Bengaluru, Charlotte, Dallas, Hyderabad, Kansas City, London, New York and Sydney. We empower our people with advanced technology, industry\-leading knowledge, and a culture centered on our core values. This approach enables our teams to deliver exceptional client service, build lasting relationships and take pride in the high\-quality work they perform.
   

  

 Trimont is an innovative firm where visionary professionals come to learn, grow, and thrive with colleagues driven by curiosity and collaboration.
   

  

**Learn:** 
 We believe ongoing learning is critical and are focused on providing a work environment where all team members can take ownership of their careers.
   

  

**Grow:** 
 We work alongside the largest institutional lenders in the world, overseeing the most significant projects in the industry. This unique opportunity allows us to broaden our skillset and develop our abilities by tackling some of the industry’s most challenging and exciting endeavors.
   

  

**Thrive:** 
 Our firm is a place where ethics and excellence meet to create an experience that matches our capabilities. There are no limits to what we as team members and as an organization, can achieve together.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a highly analytical and business\-focused
 **Analyst Data \& Insights Professional** 
 to transform raw data into actionable insights that inform strategic decision\-making. This high\-impact role sits at the intersection of
 **data analytics, business intelligence, automation, and GenAI\-enabled insight generation** 
 .
   

  

 The ideal candidate will champion a
 **data\-driven and AI\-aware culture** 
 , mentor others, and continuously evolve analytics capabilities using modern tools and responsible AI practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Insights \& Strategy**
* Transform complex data into actionable insights that support strategic and operational decision\-making.
* Identify trends, outliers, and key performance drivers across functions using advanced analytics, structured querying, and AI\-enabled techniques.
* Develop executive\-ready dashboards and reports with strong narrative context and clear recommendations.
* Leverage GenAI tools to accelerate insight discovery, analysis, and storytelling where appropriate.


**Reporting \& Analytics Excellence**
* Own the full reporting lifecycle: data sourcing, SQL\-based data modeling, automation, validation, visualization, and enhancement.
* Write, optimize, and maintain complex, performant SQL queries and reusable datasets.
* Ensure consistency, accuracy, and clarity in reporting outputs.
* Define and govern data definitions, metric logic, and standards to maintain a single version of the truth, including responsible use of AI\-generated outputs.


**Tools, Automation \& Platform Development**
* Design, build, and maintain Power Apps solutions to streamline data capture, workflows, and business self\-service.
* Use VBA to automate repetitive reporting tasks, data preparation, and operational workflows.
* Apply Python for data analysis, transformation, and exploratory analytics as needed.
* Integrate Power Platform, BI tools, and AI\-enabled capabilities to deliver scalable and intuitive analytics solutions.
* Apply GenAI fundamentals such as prompt design, insight validation, and workflow augmentation to improve productivity and reporting efficiency.
* Continuously evaluate and enhance the BI and analytics ecosystem, including emerging AI and GenAI capabilities.


**Innovation, Enablement \& Leadership**
* Mentor analysts and business partners on advanced SQL, analytical thinking, GenAI fundamentals, and effective insight development.
* Explore opportunities in predictive analytics, forecasting, and AI\-assisted modeling to move from descriptive to prescriptive insights.
* Stay current on GenAI trends and responsible AI practices, assessing applicability to analytics and decision support.
* Promote best practices, reusable assets, and standards to strengthen a data\-driven culture.


**Required Qualifications**
* 0\-1 year of hands\-on experience in analytics, business intelligence, or reporting roles
* Strong expertise in SQL, including complex query development, optimization, and dataset modeling
* Proven experience building high\-quality Power BI dashboards with strong performance and business context
* Demonstrated ability to analyze data to identify trends, outliers, and performance drivers
* Experience managing the end\-to\-end reporting and analytics lifecycle
* Working knowledge of Power Apps and the Power Platform for data capture, automation, or self\-service
* Basic proficiency in VBA and Python for data analysis, reporting automation, and workflow efficiency
* Exposure to GenAI tools or analytics copilots, including prompt design and validation of AI\-generated insights
* Strong communication skills with the ability to translate analysis into concise, executive\-ready narratives
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field (or equivalent experience)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Advanced Power BI skills, including data modeling, DAX, and performance optimization
* Experience defining data governance standards and metric frameworks
* Hands\-on use of GenAI to augment analytics workflows (insight discovery, summarization, narration)
* Exposure to forecasting, trend analysis, or basic predictive analytics
* Experience in financial services, operations, SaaS, or enterprise analytics environments
* Strong background working with large datasets and multiple data sources
* Understanding of responsible AI practices, including validation, bias awareness, and data privacy


 Trimont is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud to support and celebrate diversity in the workplace. If you have a disability and need an accommodation or assistance with the application process and/or using our website, please contact us. We are proud to maintain a drug\-free policy, ensuring that our community is a secure and productive space for all our team members.

description:

 CIBC is a leading North American bank, with a history of more than 150 years of living our purpose \- to help make your ambition a reality. From digital banking to community impact, we’re proud to drive progress for our clients and our communities. **About CIBC India:** 




 CIBC India is a technology and operations hub in Hyderabad, where you’ll be part of our highly engaged and global team, and play a central role in supporting our growth. Whether you’re driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you’ll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting\-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.
 



  





**What CIBC India Offers:** 




 At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.
 



 We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance\-based incentive programs, a family\-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points\-based recognition program.
 



 Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide
 



 We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing (Position Summary):** 




 As a Business Intelligence Consultant, you will play a key role in modernizing business reporting and analytics at CIBC. This role sits within the business intelligence function and is focused on reporting, dashboarding, analytics, and migration of business reporting assets to cloud\-based environments.
 



 You will work closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs, translate requirements into effective dashboards and analyses, and support the modernization of legacy SAS/SQL reporting solutions into Python\- and BI\-based reporting assets.
 



 This is not a backend ETL pipeline engineering role. The primary focus is on business reporting, analytics, dashboard development, ad hoc analysis, and migration of business\-owned reporting assets, logic, and code to modern reporting environments.
 



 At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on\-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.
 



  





**How You’ll Succeed:** 




**Business Intelligence \& Reporting Delivery:** 



* Deliver business intelligence solutions including recurring reports, dashboards, scorecards, and ad hoc analyses that support business decision\-making.
* Build, enhance, and maintain management reporting and self\-service dashboards for business users and leadership teams.
* Use Power BI or Tableau to create clear, scalable, and business\-friendly visual reporting solutions.



  





**Business Partnership:** 



* Partner directly with business stakeholders to gather requirements, understand reporting priorities, define KPIs and metrics, and validate outputs.
* Translate business questions into actionable reporting and analytics solutions.
* Communicate insights and reporting logic clearly to business audiences.
* Reporting Modernization \& Migration
* Support the migration of legacy business reporting assets and SAS/SQL\-based reporting processes into modern cloud\-based reporting solutions.
* Convert and simplify legacy reporting logic into SQL and Python\-based workflows for reporting and analysis.
* Help modernize business\-owned reports, dashboards, and analytical code while preserving business logic and reporting accuracy.



  





**Data Analysis \& Preparation:** 



* Use SQL and Python to source, prepare, reconcile, validate, and analyze data for reporting purposes.
* Perform data checks and reconciliations to ensure reports are accurate, complete, and reliable.
* Apply sound business logic and data interpretation to reporting outputs.



  





**Governance \& Quality:** 



* Ensure reporting outputs align with data governance, control, and quality standards.
* Document assumptions, calculations, metric definitions, and reporting logic as needed.
* Identify opportunities to improve report quality, usability, and efficiency.



  





**Collaboration:** 



* Work with business, analytics, and technology partners to enable reporting solutions and resolve data or reporting issues.
* Collaborate across teams while maintaining a primary focus on business intelligence delivery, not pipeline engineering or infrastructure ownership.



  





**Continuous Improvement:** 



* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive reporting activities and streamline reporting workflows.
* Stay current with BI and analytics best practices and recommend improvements to reporting processes and tools.
* Use AI or automation tools where appropriate to support report migration, code conversion, and quality assurance.



  





**Who You Are:** 



* 7\+ years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, analytics, MIS, or business\-facing data roles
* Strong hands\-on proficiency in SQL and Python
* Strong experience building dashboards and business reports using Power BI or Tableau
* Proven experience working with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver reporting solutions
* Experience with legacy reporting environments such as SAS and/or SQL\-based reporting assets
* Strong understanding of KPI development, report logic, reconciliation, and data quality validation
* Ability to translate business needs into dashboards, metrics, and analytical outputs
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills
* Exposure to Azure and Databricks is a nice\-to\-have, not required
* Experience using AI or automation tools to support reporting migration or reporting quality is an asset.



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile:** 




**We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience in:** 



* Business Intelligence Reporting
* Management reporting
* Dashboard development
* Ad hoc analytics
* Report migration / reporting modernization
* Stakeholder\-facing analytics delivery
* KPI and performance reporting
* Candidates whose background is primarily in ETL pipeline development, source\-to\-target data engineering, or cloud infrastructure management without strong business intelligence delivery experience may be less aligned to this role.



  





**Job Dimensions:** 




 Individual contributor role focused on delivering business reporting and analytics solutions that support business unit goals High interaction with business stakeholders and reporting consumers Strong emphasis on reporting outcomes, dashboard usability, data quality, and insight generation Compliance Requirements Comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines, and controls

 By proceeding with the creation of a profile and submitting an application in response to this job posting, you acknowledge and agree that your personal data will be collected, used, retained and disclosed by CIBC India and its affiliates, as described in the Candidate Privacy Statement.

title: Senior Business Intelligence Consultant [T500-29450]
description:
**About CIBC:** 




 CIBC is a leading North American bank, with a history of more than 150 years of living our purpose \- to help make your ambition a reality. Client relationships are at the center of our strategy, and our growth is enabled by a highly engaged and connected global team. From digital banking to community impact, we’re proud to drive progress for our clients and our communities. Recognized for our culture, award\-winning innovation and community investment, CIBC continues to evolve by putting people and progress at the centre of everything we do.
 



  





**About CIBC India:** 




 CIBC India is a technology and operations hub in Hyderabad, where you’ll be part of our highly engaged and global team, and play a central role in supporting our growth. Whether you’re driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you’ll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting\-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.
 



  





**What CIBC India Offers:** 




 At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.
 



 We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance\-based incentive programs, a family\-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points\-based recognition program.
 



 Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide
 



 We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing (Position Summary):** 




 As a Senior Business Intelligence Consultant, you will lead the modernization of business reporting and analytics at CIBC, partnering closely with the Analytics Head Office in Toronto and key business stakeholders.
 



 This role sits within the business intelligence function and is focused on business reporting, dashboarding, analytics, and migration of business\-owned reporting assets and logic to modern cloud\-based environments. You will help transform legacy SAS/SQL reporting into scalable, business\-ready reporting solutions using SQL, Python, and Power BI or Tableau.
 



 This is not a backend ETL pipeline engineering role or a source\-system data migration role. The primary focus is on management reporting, dashboard development, ad hoc analysis, reporting logic modernization, and business insight delivery.
 



 At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on\-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.
 



  





**How You’ll Succeed:** 



* Reporting \& BI Solution Leadership.
* Lead the modernization of legacy reporting assets and deliver business\-ready reporting solutions that support decision\-making.
* Own the development and enhancement of dashboards, scorecards, recurring management reports, and ad hoc analyses.
* Deliver reporting solutions that are accurate, scalable, user\-friendly, and aligned to business priorities.



  





**Business Partnership:** 



* Partner closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs, define KPIs and metrics, and translate business questions into actionable reporting solutions.
* Act as a trusted advisor on reporting design, metric interpretation, and business insight delivery.
* Present findings, reporting logic, and recommendations clearly to business audiences.
* Reporting Migration \& Modernization
* Lead the migration of business reporting assets, SAS/SQL\-based reporting logic, and analytical workflows into modern cloud\-based reporting solutions.
* Convert legacy reporting code and logic into SQL\- and Python\-based solutions that preserve business meaning and reporting integrity.
* Rationalize, simplify, and modernize legacy reports and reporting processes for improved usability and efficiency.



  





**Dashboarding \& Analytics:** 



* Develop advanced dashboards and business intelligence reports using Power BI or Tableau.
* Use SQL and Python for analysis, reporting logic, reconciliation, validation, and data preparation in support of reporting outcomes.
* Deliver ad hoc analysis and insight generation for business and leadership teams.
* Data Quality, Controls \& Governance
* Ensure reporting outputs are accurate, complete, traceable, and aligned to governance standards and controls.
* Document business logic, metric definitions, assumptions, and key transformations as needed.
* Identify and resolve data quality issues that affect reporting integrity.



  





**Stakeholder \& Team Leadership:** 



* Build strong relationships with business partners, analytics teams, and related stakeholders across functions.
* Coach and support team members or junior analysts as appropriate, fostering strong reporting and analytical practices.
* Contribute thought leadership on BI/reporting modernization and business value delivery.
* Continuous Improvement
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive reporting activities and improve reporting workflows.
* Use AI or automation tools where appropriate to support code conversion, reporting quality checks, and productivity gains.
* Recommend improvements to reports, dashboards, business processes, and reporting operating models.



  





**Experience:** 



* 10\+ years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, analytics, MIS, or business\-facing data roles.
* Strong experience delivering management reporting, dashboards, ad hoc analysis, and KPI\-based reporting.
* Proven experience modernizing or migrating legacy reporting assets, including SAS/SQL\-based reporting logic.
* Strong track record of working directly with business stakeholders to define and deliver reporting solutions.
* Experience leading or significantly contributing to reporting transformation or reporting modernization initiatives.
* Experience using AI tools or automation in reporting migration, reporting quality assurance, or analytics workflows is an asset.



  





**Who You Are:** 



* Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Power BI or Tableau; one of these should be a core strength.
* Deep experience in business reporting, dashboarding, analytics, and stakeholder\-facing insight delivery.
* Strong understanding of KPI development, metric definition, reconciliation, and reporting controls.
* Ability to translate business requirements into practical, high\-quality reporting solutions.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrated leadership capability, including coaching, mentoring, or leading workstreams.
* Experience with SAS and legacy reporting environments is strongly preferred.
* Exposure to Azure and Databricks is a nice\-to\-have, not a core requirement.
* Familiarity with automation and AI\-enabled productivity tools is an asset.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Exposure to Azure\-based analytics environments.
* Databricks familiarity.
* Experience with business reporting migration into cloud\-based reporting platforms.
* Experience with both Power BI and Tableau.
* Financial services or regulated industry reporting experience.



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile:** 




**We are particularly interested in candidates with backgrounds such as:** 



* Senior Business Intelligence consultant.
* Reporting and analytics lead.
* BI developer / BI analyst with strong business engagement.
* MIS / management reporting lead.
* Dashboard and KPI reporting specialist.
* Reporting modernization lead.
* Candidates whose experience is primarily in ETL pipeline development, data ingestion, backend data engineering, cloud infrastructure, or source\-to\-target migration without strong business intelligence and reporting delivery experience may be less aligned to this role.



  





**Privacy:** 




 By proceeding with the creation of a profile and submitting an application in response to this job posting, you acknowledge and agree that your personal data will be collected, used, retained and disclosed by CIBC India and its affiliates, as described in the Candidate Privacy Statement.

title: Applied Scientist II, Worldwide Returns & Recommerce - Science
description:
**Description**
 Welcome to the Worldwide Returns \& ReCommerce team (WWR\&R) at Amazon.com.
   

  

 WWR\&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. Our goal is to achieve the three zeroes: zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects. We do this by developing products and driving truly innovative operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned and damaged product value, keep thousands of tons of waste from landfills, and create the best customer returns experience in the world. We have an eye to the future – we create long\-term value at Amazon by focusing not just on the bottom line, but on the planet. We are building the most sustainable re\-use channel we can by driving multiple aspects of the Circular Economy for Amazon – Returns \& ReCommerce.
   

  

 Amazon WWR\&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re\-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop highly respected product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.
   

  

 You will help create everything from customer\-facing and vendor\-facing websites to the internal software and tools behind the reverse\-logistics process. You can develop scalable, high\-availability solutions to solve complex and broad business problems.
   

  

 We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work\-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.
   

  

 Amazon is earth’s most customer\-centric company and through WWR\&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns \& ReCommerce team!
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design, develop, and evaluate highly innovative models for Natural Language Programming (NLP), Large Language Model (LLM), or Large Computer Vision Models.
* Use SQL to query and analyze the data.
* Use Python, Jupyter notebook, and Pytorch to train/test/deploy ML models.
* Use machine learning and analytical techniques to create scalable solutions for business problems.
* Research and implement novel machine learning and statistical approaches.
* Mentor interns.
* Work closely with data \& software engineering teams to build model implementations and integrate successful models and algorithms in production systems at very large scale.


**About The Team**
 When a customer returns a package to Amazon, the request and package will be passed through our WWRR machine learning (ML) systems so that we could improve the customer experience, identify return root cause, optimize re\-use, and evaluate the returned package. Our problems touch multiple modalities spanning from: textual, categorical, image, to speech data.
   

  

 We operate at large scale and rely on state\-of\-the\-art modeling techniques to power our ML models: XGBoost, BERT, Vision Transformers, Large Language Models.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of building models for business application experience
* PhD, or Master's degree and 4\+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
* 3\+ years of programming in Java, C\+\+, Python or related language experience
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high\-performance computing
* Experience with popular deep learning frameworks such as MxNet and Tensor Flow


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
* Experience in building speech recognition, machine translation and natural language processing systems (e.g., commercial speech products or government speech projects)
* Experience developing and implementing deep learning algorithms, particularly with respect to computer vision algorithms
* Experience in patents or publications at top\-tier peer\-reviewed conferences or journals


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Manager - RGM
description:
**Overview**
 ICC is a growing function within PepsiCo that leverages one strategy and common approach to introduce new, technology\-driven capabilities and elevate service quality while meeting current and future business needs. PEP RGM is a key priority function where transformation, technology, strategy and capabilities enablement are aimed to be the best in class, and to be standardized and deployed globally. The vision is to develop playbook to develop analytic packs with insights across Brand Ladders, Channel PPA, In\-Market Pack Price realization, Trade Investment Strategy, Promo ROI and Mix Management. This work will accelerate growth through efficient positioning across price tiers, optimized channel\-based package types, right pricing, well directed commercial strategy and increase promotional ROI driven by enhanced and standardized insights.
   

  

 This position will be part of the ICC \- Revenue growth Management organization. The incumbement will work for different markets across the globe and work with different stakeholders to develop RGM playbooks and ensure analytics execution
   

  

**Responsibilities**

* ICC RGM analyst will be responsible for conducting data analyses across all RGM levers \- Pricing, Promotion, Assortment Mix and Trade Investment
* Lead data aggregation and harmonization that will form the backbone of RGM analytics
* Collaborate with Market Cluster Leads to understand market dynamics and incorporate market feedback into analyses
* Bring out Next Gen Revenue Management insights by implementing advance analytics
* Integrate insights comprehensive summaries for RGM Tower Lead and RGM leader
* Improve understanding of pricing, promotions, pack architecture and trade investments through use of data analytic tools and visualization tools
* Improve processes of analyses and data management across category business units and marketing functions
* Develop observations/insights for each analysis in the RGM playbook and synthesize insights across analyses to create a storyline of opportunities
* Implement continued improvements and simplifications of processes, standardization of reporting and optimal use of technology
* Create an inclusive and collaborative environment
* Adavanced Analytics – Price Elasticity, Promotion Effectiveness and knowledge of Python, R, Tableau/Power Bi


 Key Activities
   

  

* Perform granular level analysis to identify growth opportunities
* Prepare data for the analyses to be performed (Data Pre\-processing Tools – Alteryx/KNIME exp preferred)
* Understand the nuances of the product category and market to tailor the output according to business needs
* Run the analyses and create visualizations (Power BI and Tableau experience preferred); prepare drill down analyses to derive insights
* Create a storyline out of various analyses output for the business to comprehend the output
* Meet the service level agreements and perform QC of the end\-to\-end analysis
* Expand playbook analytic pack scope to include additional analyses upon alignment with market


**Qualifications**
* \+7 years of experience in Retail Analytics/Category Management/Revenue Management
* 2\-3 years of relevant professional experience working with large data sets and experience in CPG /Consulting / ICC Organizations
* Experience in any of the RGM lever practices\- Pricing, Promo, Assortment, Trade Investment
* Strong analytics skills with expertise in data analytics and data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI
* Strong Advanced Analytics acumen, Agile ways of working, managing high end data science
* Prior experience in data analytics to derive data driven insights and consolidate them to generate recommendations
* Experience in developing data\-driven models for sales and marketing function
* Ability to handle multiple work streams simultaneously and to tight deadlines in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.
* Experience working with stakeholders in North America, LATAM, APAC, or EMEA markets (preferred)
* Very strong analytical skills – excellent competency in MS Excel is a must, as is experience of managing complex, incomplete \& inconsistent datasets and defining strategic analytics (market sizing/growth forecasts etc).
* Experience in Tableau / Power Bi is preferred
* Proven experience using PowerPoint and ability to producing visually compelling presentations (i.e. beyond just operating the software) that are impactful with a senior audience
* Clarity in communication (English language) to enable production of a very high standard of commentary that is impactful and credible amongst our most senior audiences.
* Bachelor’s in commerce/business administration/Engg., Master’s degree is a plus
* Best\-in\-class time management skills, ability to multitask, set priorities and plan

title: Associate, Channel Operations – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN)
description:
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
 At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
   

  

 Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As the Associate, Channel Operations – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN), you will support execution of U.S. Channel operations within the Contracts \& Pricing Execution function. This role will support contract update processing, CDP maintenance, GCPS processing, scorecard generation, payment validation, DOH analysis, reconciliation activities, reporting, controls, documentation, and operational improvement initiatives supporting Channel Payments and Channel Analytics processes.
   

  

 The role will partner with Channel Managers, AIN team members, ATO Channel SMEs, National Account Managers, Finance, Commercial Operations, Pricing, Trade Operations, Analytics teams, Information Systems, and other U.S.\-based stakeholders to support accurate, timely, and compliant Channel execution. The Associate will be expected to learn Channel processes through structured KT, shadowing, reverse shadowing, and supervised execution prior to taking on broader independent responsibilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
*Channel Operations \& Execution*
* Support day\-to\-day execution of Channel operations including CDP updates, GCPS maintenance, payment package preparation, scorecard generation, tracker maintenance, reporting support, and documentation management.
* Execute assigned standard\-state Channel activities in accordance with SOPs, desktop procedures, validation checklists, quality standards, and established timelines.
* Maintain accurate trackers for contract updates, CDP changes, scorecard status, waiver activity, payment readiness, reconciliations, open items, and evidence retention.
* Escalate risks, missing information, data anomalies, access issues, late amendments, waiver concerns, or processing exceptions to the Channel Manager and retained ATO owners.


*CDP \& GCPS Support*
* Support Conga review activities, contract amendment tracking, Monthly and Quarterly CDP Update preparation, and maintenance of supporting documentation.
* Perform standard CDP maintenance activities and support GCPS setup and configuration updates for approved contract, pricing, fee, rebate, strategy, and program changes.
* Assist with CDP\-to\-GCPS validation, peer review support, discrepancy documentation, and issue resolution tracking.
* Maintain supporting files including master files, strategy trackers, product updates, waiver trackers, and contract\-related documentation.


*Scorecards, Validation \& Payment Support*
* Generate and maintain scorecards using approved master files, DOH inputs, net sales data, and contractual parameters.
* Perform first\-pass validation of scorecards, payment calculations, performance reports, reconciliations, and supporting reporting outputs.
* Support payment package preparation, payment tracker updates, variance research, documentation preparation, and approval package readiness.
* Investigate standard discrepancies and coordinate supporting data collection for manager review.


*Analytics, Reconciliation \& Reporting*
* Support net sales reconciliation activities across SAP, GCPS, IntegriChain, and related reporting sources.
* Perform recurring DOH calculations, direct sales validation, 852/867 review support, variance analysis, and compliance reporting activities.
* Assist with trend reporting, scorecard reporting, performance reporting, payment package support, and routine operational dashboards.
* Maintain audit\-ready supporting workpapers and reconciliation documentation.


*Product Launch \& Master Data Support*
* Support routine product launch tracking activities, MMDS documentation updates, master data coordination, and approved pricing update activities.
* Assist with price list maintenance, documentation readiness, product setup tracking, and launch\-related reporting.
* Maintain launch documentation, approvals, and supporting records in accordance with SOP requirements.


*Compliance, Controls \& Audit Readiness*
* Execute work in accordance with Channel SOPs, SOX controls, documentation requirements, and compliance expectations.
* Maintain audit\-ready evidence supporting validations, reconciliations, payment activities, approvals, and operational controls.
* Support internal audits, SOX reviews, KT activities, documentation updates, and process compliance reviews.
* Escalate data integrity, compliance, operational, or financial risks promptly and support remediation efforts.


**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The ideal candidate is a detail\-oriented operations professional with strong analytical, documentation, reconciliation, and process execution capabilities. This individual should demonstrate ownership, accuracy, continuous learning, stakeholder collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset while supporting a highly controlled Channel operations environment.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or master’s degree in finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Engineering, Analytics, or related discipline.
* 2 to 5 years of experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, finance operations, Channel operations, managed markets, revenue management, analytics, contracting operations, or related business operations.
* Strong Excel, reporting, documentation, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, follow SOPs, and work effectively in a controlled operational environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Exposure to Channel Payments, distributor agreements, fee and rebate administration, Gross\-to\-Net operations, contract operations, or pharmaceutical commercial operations.
* Experience with Model N GCPS, SAP, Conga, IntegriChain, SharePoint, Tableau, Qlik, Power BI, Power Query, Alteryx, Power Automate, or similar business systems.
* Understanding of DOH calculations, scorecards, reconciliations, payment validation, contract amendments, compliance reporting, and operational controls.
* Experience supporting SOP development, issue tracking, audit support, testing, process documentation, automation, or continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong communication, collaboration, attention\-to\-detail, and stakeholder management skills in a global operating model.

* Monitor vendor spending and financial commitments.
* Support invoice reconciliation and financial tracking activities.

* Utilize automation platforms such as Power Automate, Automation Anywhere, or similar tools to improve operational efficiency.
* Support implementation of AI and automation initiatives across project financial processes.

* Document project financial processes and recommend enhancements.
* Implement best practices that improve financial governance, reporting consistency, and operational efficiency.

* Communicate financial information to both technical and non\-technical audiences.

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Information Systems, or related field.
* 4–7 years of experience in Project Financial Management, Financial Analysis, PMO Operations, or related disciplines.
* Experience supporting medium to large\-scale technology or business transformation projects.
* Experience working within matrixed global organizations.


**Financial \& Business Skills**
* Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, accruals, financial reporting, and variance analysis.
* Knowledge of project lifecycle financial management.
* Understanding of procurement processes and Purchase Order management.
* Ability to analyze large datasets and identify meaningful insights.


**Technical Skills**
* Intermediate to advanced experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Workday Financials, or similar).
* Experience using Project Portfolio Management tools (ServiceNow PPM, Planview, MS Project, or equivalent).
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including Pivot Tables, Power Query, and financial modeling.
* Strong PowerPoint and data visualization capabilities.
* Experience with Power BI or similar analytics platforms.


**AI \& Automation Skills**
* Experience using Generative AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of prompt engineering and AI\-assisted business processes.
* Knowledge of workflow automation tools such as Power Automate, Automation Anywhere, or UiPath.
* Ability to identify and implement automation opportunities that improve productivity and reduce manual effort.
* Basic understanding of data governance and Responsible AI principles.

title: Risk Analytics - Product Analyst - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS \- Delivery Excellence Senior position**
 Within last decade, cost of delivery and Delivery excellence has become the most critical factors to run successful and popular businesses spread around the globe. To support such a dynamic and fast paced IT transformation industry, we are using various cutting\-edge Delivery Excellence models and tools with relentless focus on automation to offer best in class and tailor\-made solutions to our clients.
   

  

 As a part of our global team you will be part of GDS projects as Delivery Excellence management professional. You will be involved in working on challenging problems and creating next generation delivery excellence platforms.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Are you a detail driven professional with a passion for translating business needs into impactful product experiences? Do you thrive at the intersection of people, process, and technology? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our Product team and help shape solutions that deliver real value to our clients and users.
   

  

 In this role, you’ll serve as a critical bridge between the business stakeholders and the development and engineering teams. Your work will influence how ideas become features, how features become products, and how products deliver meaningful outcomes in a fast paced, evolving environment.
   

  

 As a key member of the Product team, you will play a hands on role in defining business requirements, crafting user stories, and ensuring that technical execution aligns seamlessly with business objectives. You will lead user acceptance testing (UAT), drive iterative testing cycles, validate enhancements, and ensure that issues or defects are accurately identified, tracked, and resolved. Your keen eye for detail and strong communication skills will help ensure that every release meets the highest standards of quality and functionality.
   

  

 This is a client facing and user centric role where you will engage with stakeholders, address queries, clarify requirements, and ensure that feedback is incorporated into continuous product improvements. You’ll gain a deep understanding of real world user behaviors, business processes, and product journeys—making this the perfect place to grow as a product focused business professional while driving meaningful impact across the product lifecycle.
   

  

 If you’re energized by the opportunity to influence product development end to end, collaborate with cross functional teams, and help bring scalable, user friendly solutions to life, this role provides the platform for you to make a lasting difference.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, ensuring alignment across stakeholders, product managers, and engineering teams.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by testing the defined test cases, validating functionality, and ensuring readiness for release.
* Support in iterative testing cycles, identifying defects, documenting issues, validating fixes, and performing regression testing as needed.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
* Serve as one of the primary liaison between business teams and engineering, providing clarifications, resolving requirement gaps, and ensuring shared understanding throughout the product lifecycle.
* Review and validate bug fixes, ensuring that resolved issues meet expected outcomes before closure.
* Engage with clients and end users, addressing queries, troubleshooting issues, and gathering feedback for continuous improvement.
* Support product rollout activities, including release planning, communication, and training support where required.
* Monitor product performance post release, identify enhancement opportunities, and contribute to backlog prioritization.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation including requirement specifications, UAT plans, test results, and user feedback logs.
* Support product strategy, roadmap planning, and end\-to\-end product lifecycle management for Internal Controls and Audit solutions.
* Partner with stakeholders across business, risk, audit, and technology teams to gather requirements and drive product adoption.
* Own MIS, reporting, KPI tracking, and executive dashboards to measure product performance and business outcomes.
* Analyse large datasets to derive insights, identify control gaps, and support decision\-making.
* Drive product implementation, rollout, user onboarding, and change management initiatives.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to define functional requirements and prioritise product backlogs.
* Identify automation and AI opportunities to enhance audit and internal control processes.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Risk Assessment – Assessment of internal processes to identify findings, vulnerabilities, and control gaps/deviations identified across applications and infrastructure.
* Control Monitoring / Testing \- Understanding of controls around Business processes, ITGC, Cyber, Data protection and privacy to perform testing of design and operational effectiveness of controls.
* Ability to create process documentation.
* Ability to understand business problems in Risk/Finance and contribute to translating them into solution or product requirements.
* Exposure (through projects or roles) to Risk, Finance, Supply Chain Operations (SCO), or related business functions preferred.
* Demonstrates interest in AI/analytics\-driven Risk solutions and their business applications.
* Agentic AI architecture\- Design agentic AI system architectures and define associated technical guardrails.
* Functional understanding of foundation models (LLMs) and associated risks. Awareness of the AI deployment lifecycle
* Control Automation – Identify automation opportunities using analytics platform to monitor the operational effectiveness on the regular basis.
* Basic exposure to Presales, solutioning, proposal support, or client presentations is a plus.
* Interest in working in tech\-enabled or AI\-led Risk products/solutions environment.
* Ability to support senior team members in product development, go\-to\-market efforts, and client engagements.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team\-player and self\-started attitude.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, global delivery environment with distributed teams.
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.
* Open to hiring across locations, aligned with EY’s Global Delivery Services (GDS) model.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Overall 3\-6 years of experience in Risk Advisory (preferably Internal Controls) experience with Big 4 or comparable professional services environment
* CA or Master’s degree in Business Administration or Risk management
* Good to have certifications – CISA, CISM, CIA, AIGP, ISO 42001, CISSP, CRISC, CCSK, ISO 27001, and others (as relevant)
* Any 1 hard tech skill is a must – Either Python or Databricks Or full stack or AI
* Product Management experience with demonstrated ownership of delivering business solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Experience in reporting, MIS, analytics, and data\-driven decision making.
* Hands\-on experience in product implementation and deployment.
* Domain expertise in Internal Controls, Risk, Compliance, or Audit (mandatory).


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 250\+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. title: Global Demand Insights Senior Associate
description:
**Global Demand Insights Senior Associate (GCF 04\)**
**Function: Global Supply Chain**
**Location: AIN**
**Reports To: Global Demand Insights Manager, Global Planning**
**Role Summary**
 The Senior Associate, Demand Insights supports Amgen's Global Supply Chain organization by generating demand analytics, forecasting insights, and performance indicators that enhance demand signal understanding, improve the consensus forecasting process and inform business decisions that ensure supply while optimizing cost.
   

  

 This role will report into the Global Demand Insights Manager, within Amgen’s Capability Center with a focus on integrating global product\-level forecasts, sales and marketing data with regional and country perspectives to identify trends and support country engagement leads in scenario planning to drive alignment between commercial expectations, supply strategies, and the Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process.
   

  

 The successful candidate will demonstrate strong analytical capability, leverage demand planning systems, statistical forecasting methods, and analytical tools to transform complex data into actionable insights that improve forecast quality, support Integrated Business Planning (IBP), and ensure alignment between commercial expectations and supply chain strategies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Demand Analytics \& Insight Generation**
* Analyze global, regional, and country\-level sales and forecast data across multiple levels of aggregation (e.g. Global Product, Regional Product, Demand Forecasting Unit)
* Identify trends, variances, and drivers impacting forecast performance, providing actionable insights and recommendations to Country Engagement Leads and Commercial partners to inform the monthly consensus forecasting process.
* Generate recurring and ad hoc analyses to support monthly forecasting and demand review processes.
* Investigate forecast variances and performance drivers, providing recommendations to improve forecast quality.


**Forecast Performance Monitoring**
* Develop and maintain KPI reporting for forecast accuracy, bias, demand performance, and forecast value\-add metrics.
* Monitor forecast performance across multiple levels of aggregation and identify exceptions requiring attention.
* Support root\-cause analysis of forecast deviations and demand changes.
* Produce exception reports and insights to support country demand reviews, highlighting key areas for discussion and follow\-up action.


**Statistical Forecasting \& Scenario Analysis**
* Apply statistical forecasting methods to generate baselines, monitor performance, and assess accuracy across time horizons
* Run opti/pessi scenario analyses to evaluate potential business risks and opportunities, supporting decision\-making within the IBP process.
* Collaborate with Forecast Model Owners and Country Engagement Leads to assess scenario outcomes and recommend actions.


**Demand Planning Systems \& Data Management**
* Maintain data quality and integrity within global demand planning systems.
* Partner with system process owners and IT to enhance system capabilities, analytics automation, and visualization.
* Support integration of advanced analytics and statistical forecasting tools into the end\-to\-end demand planning process.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify opportunities to automate reporting, streamline processes, and enhance analytical capabilities.
* Support implementation of advanced analytics, visualization, and forecasting tools.
* Contribute to the evolution of demand insight methodologies and best practices.
* Share knowledge and support capability development across the broader forecasting community.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner closely with Global, Regional, and Country Forecasting, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams to align demand insights with business objectives.
* Provide analytic support and insight generation for global and regional demand review forums.
* Collaborate with stakeholders across GCF, IBP, and Commercial Operations to evolve forecasting capability and maturity.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Supply Chain, Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
* 2\+ years of experience in demand planning, forecasting, supply chain analytics, commercial analytics, or related disciplines.
* Proficiency with global demand planning systems (Anaplan, Kinaxis, SAP or equivalent).
* Experience working with large datasets and performing quantitative analysis.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Good communication skills with the ability to translate analytics into business\-relevant narratives for cross\-functional stakeholders


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of statistical forecasting principles and demand planning processes.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar data visualization tools.
* Familiarity with SQL, Python, R, or other analytics tools.
* Understanding of Integrated Business Planning (IBP) processes.
* Experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare industry.


**Key Performance Indicators**
* Improvement in forecast accuracy and bias metrics across key global products.
* Timely delivery and accuracy of forecast performance reporting.
* Quality and impact of insights provided to forecasting and commercial stakeholders.
* Data quality and integrity within demand planning systems.
* Successful completion of analytics automation and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Stakeholder satisfaction with reporting and analytical support.


**Our Commitment**
 At Amgen, we empower our teams to
 **turn insights into impact** 
 . The Global Demand Sr Associate will play a pivotal role in connecting data, analytics, and business strategy — ensuring that every forecast informs meaningful action to better serve patients worldwide.

title: Analyst II, Portfolio Strategy Analytics
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose\-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
   

  

 Candidate will play a critical role on the portfolio analytics team, bringing broad pharma industry experience across portfolio strategy, pipeline building, and commercial data analysis. The right candidate combines a strong grounding in therapeutic area landscapes and the drug development lifecycle with hands\-on experience across pharma industry databases, and can independently translate large, complex datasets into decision\-ready insight for senior stakeholders
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Portfolio Strategy Analysis** 
 Lead portfolio strategy analyses including competitor concentration, portfolio benchmarking by therapeutic indication, whitespace assessment, and pipeline gap identification.
   

  

**Commercial Data Analysis** 
 Conduct commercial data analysis and market assessments to inform leadership on portfolio health, asset attractiveness, and competitive positioning.
   

  

**Therapeutic Area \& Landscape Analysis** 
 Maintain deep working knowledge of therapeutic area landscapes, drug development, and commercialization dynamics to contextualize portfolio insights.
   

  

**Large Dataset \& Complex Analysis** 
 Work with large, complex datasets from pharma industry databases (Evaluate, Citeline, GlobalData, IQVIA, AlphaSense, etc.) and public sources (SEC filings, trial registries, patents, conference materials, investor communications) to ensure accuracy and reliability of analyses.
   

  

**Independent Workstream Ownership** 
 Own multiple workstreams end to end with minimal supervision, from framing the question and gathering data through to final output and recommendation.
   

  

**Stakeholder Partnering** 
 Support Commercial, Medical, R\&D, Business Development, and portfolio strategy stakeholders, translating their questions into analytical approaches and delivering answers they can act on.
   

  

**Reporting \& Communication** 
 Communicate insights clearly to senior, non\-technical stakeholders using strong Excel and PowerPoint outputs; synthesize complex analyses into a clear narrative.
   

  

 Collaborate cross\-functionally and provide guidance and mentorship to junior analysts as required.
   

  

**Skills And Competencies**
* Must\-have Understanding of pharma industry databases (Evaluate Pharma, Citeline, AlphaSense, etc.), advanced technical proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel, and the ability to work accurately with large datasets and perform complex analysis, backed by portfolio analytics experience and a solid understanding of the pharmaceutical landscape.
* Preferred/plus
* Excel modeling built from scratch; SQL / VBA / Python for reporting
* Power BI / Tableau dashboarding
* Nice\-to\-have Databricks exposure


**Experience**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Healthcare, Business, or a related quantitative discipline.
* 3\-6 years of experience in pharmaceutical/biotech portfolio analytics and strategy
* Strong understanding of therapeutic area landscapes, the drug development lifecycle, commercialization, and market dynamics.
* Hands\-on experience with pharma industry databases and commercial/clinical datasets such as Evaluate Pharma, Citeline, GlobalData, IQVIA, Trialtrove, BioMedTracker, AlphaSense, or similar.
* Demonstrated ability to work with large datasets and perform complex analyses, owning a workstream end to end with light supervision.
* Experience working in a matrixed pharmaceutical, biotech, consulting, or GCC environment is preferred.

 As part of the Global Insights Services Hub, support the growth of PepsiCo's Food business by developing and maintaining reports using diverse data sources. Deliver periodic and ad hoc business performance reviews, respond to data requests, and generate actionable insights to support decision\-making.
   

  

 Contribute to key business meetings by preparing ad\-hoc analyses, enhancing reporting outputs for greater clarity and efficiency, and supporting strategic discussions.  What the role will provide the candidate?

title: Enforcement Detection Analyst, YouTube, Trust and Safety
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in data analysis, including identifying trends, generating summary statistics, and drawing insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
* 2 years of experience managing projects and defining project scope, goals, and deliverables.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience or demonstrated interest in anti\-abuse operations at scale.
* Track record of leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI technologies to solve business problems.
* Ability to work with a variety of stakeholders to gather requirements, explain models and iterate to make improvements.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical abilities with a history of going above and beyond to make operational improvements and solve tough problems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


**About The Job**
 Fast\-paced, dynamic, and proactive, YouTube’s Trust \& Safety team is dedicated to making YouTube a safe place for users, viewers, and content creators around the world to create, and express themselves. Whether understanding and solving their online content concerns, navigating within global legal frameworks, or writing and enforcing worldwide policy, the Trust \& Safety team is on the frontlines of enhancing the YouTube experience, building internet safety, and protecting free speech in our ever\-evolving digital world.
   

  

 At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. Working at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun.
   

  

 YouTube’s Trust and Safety team is dedicated to making YouTube a safe place for users, viewers, and content creators around the world. Whether understanding and solving their online content concerns, navigating within global legal frameworks, or writing and enforcing worldwide policy, the Trust and Safety team is on the frontlines of enhancing the YouTube experience, building internet safety, and protecting free speech in our ever\-evolving digital world.
   

  

 As an Enforcement Detection Analyst , you will be directly responsible for ensuring that we effectively identify and remove disruptive content and users as quickly as possible, in an environment where hundreds of hours of new content is uploaded every minute.  Our company is a global health care leader with a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines and animal health products. The difference between potential and achievement lies in the spark that fuels innovation and inventiveness; this is the space where our company has codified its legacy for over a century. Our company’s success is backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.

**Global Operations Sourcing** 
 is responsible for the development and implementation of all supplier management strategies and initiatives, improving supply chain resiliency, and driving improvements in cost, supplier performance and working capital, in support of manufacturing and supply of our company products.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for the gathering, creating, delivering, tracking, analyzing, modeling, and managing data for various strategic initiatives in its assigned teams. Will enable progress on projects and procurement organizational objectives, and accelerate organizational performance through effective project management and communications, strategy execution, and focused team performance.

* Support strategic and operating objectives for the procurement function including product sourcing, supply risk management, supplier performance improvement, cost reduction, supplier diversity development, working capital improvement, and supplier relationship management.
* Work with cross functional teams including Legal, Finance, Procure\-to\-Pay, internal stakeholders, and external suppliers.
* Conduct detailed market analyses looking at facts and data with the objective of providing deep and meaningful insights
* Implement procurement strategies and execute tactical procurement processes. Serve as a resource regarding processes, procedures and systems for procurement function.
* Support selection of suppliers to ensure appropriate savings and service levels. Ensure that all legal contract requirements are met. Manage relationships with selected external contacts to ensure optimal team performance.
* Enforce compliance with all Global Procurement policies and procedures by using a data driven business case approach.

* Supplier and Supply Market Analysis – To conduct rigorous market intelligence and detailed supplier and supply market analyses, to provide deep and meaningful insight to sourcing teams.

At times, this will require supplier visits to create a complete understanding of the cost structure of suppliers and develop cost reduction opportunities.

* Risk Assessment and Mitigation – To conduct effective risk assessment (including Financial Solvency Analysis, compliance with FCPA, Business Partner Code of Conduct, etc.) and establish appropriate risk mitigation plans within the supply\-base pursuant to our company Manufacturing Division's risk management framework.
* Category Team Membership – To be an active member of one or more category teams using the techniques and content created in above as input in the creation of breakthrough strategies delivering cost reduction targets.
